
## Neon

`Glow` draws one shape as a stack of passes: a wide bloom and a coloured glow behind, a solid core,
a hot white highlight and a thin rim. `neon()` is that recipe. Pass your own layers for anything else.

```ts

const bolt = new Glow({
    draw: (g) => g.triangle(12, -50, -32, 8, 6, 2).triangle(-12, 50, 32, -8, -6, -2),
    layers: neon(0xffb800, { size: 100 }),
});
```

Live demo `glow-neon` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { radial, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Glow, neon } from 'pixi-silk/glow';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const bolt = (s: number) => (g: SilkGraphics) =>
    g
        .triangle(s * 0.12, -s * 0.5, -s * 0.32, s * 0.08, s * 0.06, s * 0.02, s * 0.03)
        .triangle(-s * 0.12, s * 0.5, s * 0.32, -s * 0.08, -s * 0.06, -s * 0.02, s * 0.03);

const core = radial([0xfff3a0, 0xffc400, 0xff8a00], { center: [0.5, 0.42], radius: 0.7 });

export default defineDemo({
    size: [720, 400],
    background: 0x050505,
    controls: {
        intensity: { type: 'range', label: 'glow', min: 0, max: 2, step: 0.05, value: 1 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const left = new Glow({ draw: bolt(170), layers: neon(0xffb800, { size: 170, core }) });
        const ticket = new SilkGraphics();
        const ring = new SilkGraphics();
        const right = new Glow({ draw: bolt(110), layers: neon(0xff9500, { size: 110, core, surface: 'light' }) });
        const title = new Text({
            text: 'Charged',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 20, fontWeight: '700', fill: 0x1c1c1e },
        });
        let last = -1;

        left.position.set(190, 200);
        ticket
            .roundRect(410, 40, 250, 320, 34, 0.6)
            .fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.5, blur: 24 })
            .roundRect(410, 40, 250, 320, 34, 0.6)
            .fill(0xf5f5f7)
            .roundRect(430, 60, 210, 230, 24, 0.6)
            .fill({ color: 0xffd60a, alpha: 0.28 })
            .stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffb800, alpha: 0.35, alignment: 'inside' });
        right.position.set(535, 175);
        title.anchor.set(0.5);
        title.position.set(535, 322);
        stage.addChild(left, ticket, ring, right, title);

        tick((t) => {
            const pulse = 0.85 + Math.sin(t * 2.2) * 0.15;

            if (params.intensity !== last) {
                last = params.intensity;
                left.setLayers(neon(0xffb800, { size: 170, core, intensity: params.intensity }));
                right.setLayers(neon(0xff9500, { size: 110, core, intensity: params.intensity, surface: 'light' }));
            }
            ring.clear()
                .circle(535, 175, 82)
                .stroke({ width: 14, color: 0xffb800, alpha: 0.3 * pulse, blur: 12 })
                .circle(535, 175, 82)
                .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.95 });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-button` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { conic, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 260;
const H = 64;

/** Point at `u` (0..1) around a pill centred at (0, 0), clockwise from the top middle. */
function onPill(u: number): [number, number] {
    const r = H / 2;
    const straight = W - H;
    const total = 2 * straight + 2 * Math.PI * r;
    let d = (((u % 1) + 1) % 1) * total;

    if (d < straight / 2) return [d, -r];
    d -= straight / 2;
    if (d < Math.PI * r) {
        const a = -Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

        return [straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r;
    if (d < straight) return [straight / 2 - d, r];
    d -= straight;
    if (d < Math.PI * r) {
        const a = Math.PI / 2 + d / r;

        return [-straight / 2 + Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r];
    }
    d -= Math.PI * r;

    return [-straight / 2 + d, -r];
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 300],
    background: 0x050508,
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const button = new Container();
        const bloom = new SilkGraphics();
        const body = new SilkGraphics();
        const spark = new SilkGraphics();
        const border = conic([0x7c3aed, 0x22d3ee, 0xa855f7, 0x7c3aed]);
        const label = new Text({
            text: '✦  Generate',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Inter, system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '600', fill: 0xffffff },
        });
        const sparkles = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => ({
            x: ((i * 97) % (W - 40)) - (W - 40) / 2,
            y: ((i * 53) % 40) - 20,
            p: i * 0.71,
        }));
        let hover = 0;
        let hot = 0;
        let burst = 0;
        let spin = 0;

        bloom.blendMode = 'add';
        spark.blendMode = 'add';
        label.anchor.set(0.5);
        button.position.set(260, 150);
        button.addChild(bloom, body, spark, label);
        button.eventMode = 'static';
        button.cursor = 'pointer';
        button.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.abs(x) <= W / 2 && Math.abs(y) <= H / 2 };
        button.on('pointerover', () => (hot = 1));
        button.on('pointerout', () => (hot = 0));
        trackGesture(button, { onTap: () => (burst = 1) });
        stage.addChild(button);

        tick((t, dt) => {
            hover += (hot - hover) * Math.min(1, dt * 8);
            burst = Math.max(0, burst - dt * 1.6);
            spin += dt * (0.25 + hover * 0.35);
            border.startAngle = spin * Math.PI * 2;
            const [sx, sy] = onPill(spin);
            const glow = 0.55 + hover * 0.35 + burst * 0.6;

            bloom
                .clear()
                .pill(-W / 2 - 6, -H / 2 - 6, W + 12, H + 12)
                .stroke({ width: 18, gradient: border, alpha: 0.35 * glow, blur: 22 })
                .circle(sx, sy, 34)
                .fill({ color: 0x9be7ff, alpha: 0.45 * glow, blur: 26 });
            body.clear()
                .pill(-W / 2, -H / 2, W, H)
                .fill(0x0c0b14)
                .stroke({ width: 1.6, gradient: border, alignment: 'inside' });
            spark.clear().circle(sx, sy, 3).fill({ color: 0xffffff, blur: 2 });
            for (const s of sparkles) {
                const a = Math.max(0, Math.sin(t * 2.4 + s.p)) ** 6 * (0.5 + hover * 0.5 + burst);

                if (a > 0.02)
                    spark
                        .star(s.x, s.y, 4, 4 + a * 3, 1, 0, 0)
                        .fill({ color: 0xe9d5ff, alpha: Math.min(1, a), blur: 0.6 });
            }
            button.scale.set(1 + burst * 0.04 - (hover > 0.5 && burst > 0.8 ? 0.02 : 0));
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Beams, waves and slices

`ray()` adds a tapered beam as two triangles, `fan()` spreads several from one point and
`spectrum()` colours them. Blurred and added, they make prisms, spotlights and hero lights.

Live demo `glow-beams` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const W = 760;

const hourglass = (g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, w: number, h: number, waist: number) =>
    g
        .triangle(cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, cx - w / 2, cy + h / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2)
        .triangle(cx - w / 2, cy - h / 2, cx, cy - waist / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2)
        .triangle(cx + w / 2, cy - h / 2, cx + w / 2, cy + h / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2)
        .triangle(cx + w / 2, cy - h / 2, cx, cy - waist / 2, cx, cy + waist / 2);

const bolt = (g: SilkGraphics, x: number, y: number, s: number) =>
    g
        .triangle(x + s * 0.12, y - s * 0.5, x - s * 0.32, y + s * 0.08, x + s * 0.06, y + s * 0.02, 3)
        .triangle(x - s * 0.12, y + s * 0.5, x + s * 0.32, y - s * 0.08, x - s * 0.06, y - s * 0.02, 3);

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, 560],
    background: 0x030305,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const beam = new SilkGraphics();
        const wave = new SilkGraphics();
        const slices = new Container();
        const strips = 9;
        const paint = linear([0xff4fd8, 0x9b5cff], { from: [0, 0], to: [1, 1] });
        const sliceArt: SilkGraphics[] = [];

        beam.blendMode = 'add';
        wave.blendMode = 'add';
        for (let i = 0; i < strips; i++) {
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();

            art.blendMode = 'add';
            clip.rect(0, 440 + i * 20 - 90, W, 20).fill(0xffffff);
            art.mask = clip;
            slices.addChild(art, clip);
            sliceArt.push(art);
        }
        stage.addChild(beam, wave, slices);

        tick((t) => {
            const breathe = 1 + Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.08;

            beam.clear();
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 95, 700, 150 * breathe, 10).fill({ color: 0x6a3cff, alpha: 0.75, blur: 34 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 95, 640, 70 * breathe, 4).fill({ color: 0xb59cff, alpha: 0.85, blur: 14 });
            hourglass(beam, W / 2, 95, 720, 8, 1.5).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.9, blur: 2.5 });
            beam.ellipse(W / 2, 95, 120, 16).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.75, blur: 16 });

            const pts = (dy: number, phase: number) => {
                const out: number[] = [];

                for (let x = 20; x <= W - 20; x += 6) out.push(x, 270 + dy + Math.sin(x / 70 + t * 1.4 + phase) * 42);

                return out;
            };

            wave.clear();
            wave.polyline(pts(0, 0), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 34,
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 0.12,
                blur: 22,
                cap: 'round',
            });
            wave.polyline(pts(-9, -0.08), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 10,
                color: 0xff3b1f,
                alpha: 0.75,
                blur: 9,
                cap: 'round',
            });
            wave.polyline(pts(-4, -0.04), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 6,
                color: 0xffa500,
                alpha: 0.7,
                blur: 5,
                cap: 'round',
            });
            wave.polyline(pts(9, 0.08), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 10,
                color: 0x2a5cff,
                alpha: 0.8,
                blur: 9,
                cap: 'round',
            });
            wave.polyline(pts(4, 0.04), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 6,
                color: 0x00d4ff,
                alpha: 0.6,
                blur: 5,
                cap: 'round',
            });
            wave.polyline(pts(0, 0), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                width: 3,
                color: 0xffffff,
                blur: 1.2,
                cap: 'round',
            });

            sliceArt.forEach((art, i) => {
                const lag = Math.sin(t * 3 + i * 0.7) * 26 + (i % 2 ? 12 : -12);

                art.clear();
                for (let k = 3; k >= 0; k--) {
                    bolt(art, W / 2 + lag + k * lag * 0.6, 440, 170).fill({
                        gradient: paint,
                        alpha: k === 0 ? 1 : 0.22 / k,
                        blur: k === 0 ? 1 : 3 + k * 3,
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Live demo `glow-icons` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { linear, SilkGraphics, type StopInput } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const HOT: StopInput[] = [
    [0, 0xfff1a8, 1],
    [0.35, 0xff9f0a, 1],
    [0.7, 0xff2d78, 0.9],
    [1, 0xff2d78, 0],
];
const COLD: StopInput[] = [
    [0, 0xd8fbff, 1],
    [0.35, 0x00c8ff, 1],
    [0.7, 0x5b4dff, 0.9],
    [1, 0x7c4dff, 0],
];

type Shape = (g: SilkGraphics) => SilkGraphics;
const S = 150;
/** Shape, ramp, and where the light leads from and trails to (fractions of the tile). */
const SHAPES: [Shape, StopInput[], [number, number], [number, number]][] = [
    [(g) => g.triangle(95, -10, 20, 95, 80, 85, 6).triangle(55, 165, 130, 60, 70, 70, 6), HOT, [0, 0], [1, 1]],
    [(g) => g.circle(80, 95, 55).triangle(80, 0, 30, 70, 130, 70, 8), COLD, [1, 0], [0, 1]],
    [(g) => g.sector(20, 130, 120, -Math.PI / 2, 0), COLD, [0, 1], [1, 0]],
    [(g) => g.arc(75, 130, 60, Math.PI, 0), HOT, [1, 1], [0, 0]],
];

export default defineDemo({
    size: [420, 420],
    background: 0x070708,
    setup({ stage }) {
        SHAPES.forEach(([shape, stops, from, to], i) => {
            const tile = new Container();
            const plate = new SilkGraphics();
            const clip = new SilkGraphics();
            const art = new SilkGraphics();
            const paint = linear(stops, { from, to });
            const arch = i === 3;

            plate.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 34, 0.6).fill(0x111114);
            clip.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 34, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
            art.blendMode = 'add';
            art.mask = clip;
            // a copy whose blur grows from the lit edge to the trailing one, so the colour bleeds out
            const blur = { from: 2, to: 34, angle: Math.atan2(to[1] - from[1], to[0] - from[0]) };

            if (arch) shape(art).stroke({ width: 40, gradient: paint, alpha: 0.85, blur });
            else shape(art).fill({ gradient: paint, alpha: 0.85, blur });
            // leading side: crisp
            if (arch) shape(art).stroke({ width: 26, gradient: paint });
            else shape(art).fill({ gradient: paint, alpha: 0.95 });
            plate.roundRect(0, 0, S, S, 34, 0.6).stroke({
                width: 1.2,
                gradient: linear([
                    [0, 0xffffff, 0.35],
                    [0.5, 0xffffff, 0.04],
                    [1, 0xffffff, 0.18],
                ]),
                alignment: 'inside',
            });
            tile.addChild(plate, art, clip);
            tile.position.set(45 + (i % 2) * (S + 30), 45 + Math.floor(i / 2) * (S + 30));
            stage.addChild(tile);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Stacked shadows

Several blurred copies behind a shape read better than one big blur: a tight one for the edge, a
wide one for the light. Each is the shape grown by its spread and blurred by half its CSS blur.

Live demo `glow-shadows` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

/** CSS-style shadows: blur is the CSS blur radius (twice the gaussian sigma), `spread` grows the shape first. */
const STACKS: [blur: number, spread: number][][] = [
    [],
    [[8, 0]],
    [
        [8, 0],
        [32, 8],
    ],
    [
        [8, 0],
        [32, 8],
        [128, 32],
    ],
];
const S = 110;

export default defineDemo({
    size: [760, 300],
    background: 0x0a0a0c,
    setup({ stage }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();

        g.blendMode = 'add';
        STACKS.forEach((stack, i) => {
            const x = 60 + i * 175;
            const y = 80;

            for (const [blur, spread] of stack) {
                g.roundRect(x, y, S, S, 26, 0.6).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.55, blur: blur / 2, spread });
            }
            g.roundRect(x, y, S, S, 26, 0.6).fill(0xffffff);
            const label = new Text({
                text: stack.length ? stack.map(([b, s]) => (s ? `${b} / ${s}` : `${b}`)).join('  +  ') : 'no shadow',
                style: { fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, monospace', fontSize: 10, fill: 0x8e8e93 },
            });

            label.anchor.set(0.5, 0);
            label.position.set(x + S / 2, 250);
            stage.addChild(label);
        });
        stage.addChildAt(g, 0);

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

# Charts

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/charts/
Section: UI widgets

> Anti-aliased line and area charts with monotone smoothing that never overshoots, fading gradient fills, dotted guides, bars and dots.

Live demo `area-chart` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const FILL = vertical(
    [
        [0, 0x0a84ff, 0.55],
        [1, 0x0a84ff, 0],
    ],
    { easing: 'smooth' },
);

export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    controls: {
        smooth: { type: 'toggle', label: 'monotone smoothing', value: true },
        dots: { type: 'toggle', label: 'dots', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const data = Array.from({ length: 13 }, (_, i) => 90 + Math.sin(i * 0.9) * 40);

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick((t) => {
            const pts = data.flatMap((v, i) => [30 + i * 35, v + Math.sin(t * 1.5 + i) * 12]);
            const smooth = params.smooth ? ('monotone' as const) : undefined;

            g.clear();
            for (const y of [40, 90, 140]) g.line(20, y, 460, y).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x3a3a3c, dash: [2, 4] });
            g.line(20, 190, 460, 190).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x636366 });
            // area between the series and a baseline; stroke() right after draws its top line
            g.area(pts, 190, { smooth }).fill(FILL).stroke({ width: 2.5, color: 0x0a84ff, cap: 'round' });
            if (params.dots)
                for (let i = 0; i < pts.length; i += 2)
                    g.circle(pts[i], pts[i + 1], 3.5)
                        .fill(0xffffff)
                        .stroke({ width: 2, color: 0x0a84ff });
        });
    },
});
```

## Areas

```ts
g.area(points, baseline, { smooth: 'monotone' });          // between a series and a y baseline
g.area(upperPoints, lowerPoints);                           // band between two series
```

`area()` fills the region under a series (or between two) with vertical columns. The columns tile
exactly and share edges without seams, so translucent fills stay uniform. The top and bottom edges
get analytic anti-aliasing.

Call `stroke()` right after to draw the series line on top:

```ts
const FILL = vertical([[0, 0x0a84ff, 0.55], [1, 0x0a84ff, 0]], { easing: 'smooth' });

g.area(points, 190, { smooth: 'monotone' }).fill(FILL).stroke({ width: 2.5, color: 0x0a84ff, cap: 'round' });
```

## Smoothing that respects the data

`smooth: 'monotone'` never overshoots. It uses Steffen's method, like d3's `curveMonotoneX`. Peaks
stay on the data points, and flat runs stay flat. Use `'catmull'` only for decorative curves. Silk
exports the `monotoneX()` helper if you need the resampled points.

## Guides, bars and dots

```ts
for (const y of [40, 90, 140]) g.line(20, y, 460, y).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x3a3a3c, dash: [2, 4] });
for (const [i, v] of values.entries()) g.roundRect(20 + i * 12, 190 - v, 8, v, 3).fill(0xffd60a);
for (const [x, y] of points) g.circle(x, y, 3.5).fill(0xffffff).stroke({ width: 2, color: 0x0a84ff });
```

## One gradient across many shapes

With `units: 'local'`, a gradient uses the graphics' coordinates instead of each shape's box. A row
of bars then samples one continuous ramp:

```ts
const HEAT = linear([[0, 0x30d158], [0.5, 0xffd60a], [1, 0xff453a]], { units: 'local', from: [0, 190], to: [0, 40] });

for (const [i, v] of values.entries()) g.roundRect(x(i), 190 - v, 8, v, 3).fill(HEAT);
```

The experiments at the end of this page are complete chart widgets built from these pieces: area charts, bar charts,
sparklines, heart-rate pills, ranges and gauges.

---

# Hit testing & events

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/hit-testing/
Section: UI widgets

> Pointer events test each shape's real distance field: rings are hollow, lines react only within their stroke and rounded corners stay rounded.

Live demo `hit-test` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// containsPoint() evaluates the real distance field: the ring is hollow, the line is only its stroke.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const items = [
            { draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) => g.circle(100, 110, 60).stroke({ width: 18, color: c }) },
            { draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) => g.roundRect(200, 50, 120, 120, 36, 0.6).fill(c) },
            {
                draw: (g: SilkGraphics, c: number) =>
                    g.polyline([350, 170, 390, 60, 450, 150]).stroke({ width: 10, cap: 'round', color: c }),
            },
        ].map((item) => {
            const g = new SilkGraphics();

            g.eventMode = 'static';
            g.cursor = 'pointer';
            stage.addChild(g);

            return { ...item, g, hover: false };
        });

        for (const item of items) {
            item.g.on('pointerover', () => (item.hover = true));
            item.g.on('pointerout', () => (item.hover = false));
        }
        tick(() => {
            for (const item of items) item.draw(item.g.clear(), item.hover ? 0x30d158 : 0x48484a);
        });
    },
});
```

Set `eventMode` and add listeners, as with any Pixi display object:

```ts
const button = new SilkGraphics();

button.eventMode = 'static';
button.cursor = 'pointer';
button.on('pointertap', () => console.log('tap'));
button.roundRect(0, 0, 160, 48, 24).fill(0x0a84ff);
```

`containsPoint()` first checks the object's bounds. Then it runs the shader's distance functions on
the CPU for the primitives under the pointer, last drawn first. A point is inside when its distance
to the painted region is negative:

- A stroked circle is a ring, so its centre is not inside.
- A line or polyline counts only within its stroke width.
- A rounded rect excludes the corners outside its radius.
- A blurred paint counts only up to its geometric edge.

You can also call it yourself:

```ts
if (g.containsPoint(g.toLocal(pointerGlobal))) { /* hovered */ }
```

In large interactive scenes, split independent targets into separate `SilkGraphics` objects. Then
each one hit-tests only its own primitives.

---

# Animation

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/animation/
Section: UI widgets

> Redraw SilkGraphics cheaply every frame. Animate with damp, dampAngle, Spring and ease so motion feels the same at 60, 120 or 144 Hz.

Live demo `spring` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, SilkGraphics, Spring } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Frame-rate independent motion: the knob glides the same at 60, 120 or 144 Hz.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 200],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        stiffness: { type: 'range', label: 'stiffness', min: 40, max: 400, step: 1, value: 170 },
        damping: { type: 'range', label: 'damping', min: 4, max: 40, step: 1, value: 14 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const hit = new Container();
        const x = new Spring(120);
        let glow = 0;
        let dragging = false;

        hit.eventMode = 'static';
        hit.hitArea = { contains: (px: number, py: number) => px >= 0 && px <= 480 && py >= 0 && py <= 200 };
        hit.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
            dragging = true;
            x.target = Math.min(440, Math.max(40, e.getLocalPosition(stage).x));
        });
        hit.on('globalpointermove', (e) => {
            if (dragging) x.target = Math.min(440, Math.max(40, e.getLocalPosition(stage).x));
        });
        hit.on('pointerup', () => (dragging = false));
        hit.on('pointerupoutside', () => (dragging = false));
        stage.addChild(g, hit);
        tick((_t, dt) => {
            x.stiffness = params.stiffness;
            x.damping = params.damping;
            x.step(dt);
            glow = damp(glow, dragging ? 1 : 0, 10, dt);
            g.clear();
            g.pill(40, 94, 400, 12).fill(0x2c2c2e);
            g.pill(40, 94, Math.max(12, x.value - 40), 12).fill(0x0a84ff);
            g.circle(x.value, 100, 22 + glow * 6).fill({ color: 0x0a84ff, alpha: 0.35 * glow, blur: 10 });
            g.circle(x.value, 100, 20).fill(0xffffff);
        });
    },
});
```

## Immediate mode is cheap

The simplest way to animate is to clear and redraw every frame. `clear()` keeps the GPU buffers.
Each primitive is 40 floats, and one instanced draw call renders them all:

```ts
app.ticker.add((ticker) => {
    const t = ticker.lastTime / 1000;

    g.clear();
    g.arcSweep(80, 80, 44, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 2 * (0.5 + 0.4 * Math.sin(t))).stroke({ width: 12, cap: 'round', color: 0x30d158 });
});
```

Put static parts in a second `SilkGraphics` and draw it once.

## Frame-rate independent motion

Easing by a fixed fraction per frame (`x += (target - x) * 0.1`) runs twice as fast on a 120 Hz
display. The helpers take the frame time instead:

```ts

x = damp(x, target, 10, dt);              // exponential approach, lambda is about 1 / seconds
angle = dampAngle(angle, target, 8, dt);  // shortest way around the circle

const spring = new Spring(0, 170, 26);    // value, stiffness, damping
spring.target = 1;
app.ticker.add((t) => draw(spring.step(t.deltaMS / 1000)));

ease.outCubic(0.5); // inOutCubic, outCubic, inOutSine, outExpo
```

`Spring.step()` integrates with fixed sub-steps, so it stays stable with large frame times.
`spring.settled` tells you when to stop redrawing.

## Sub-pixel motion

Slow-moving shapes glide instead of snapping from pixel to pixel. Silk renders coordinates exactly
as given, and `createSilkApp` turns off pixel rounding. The [sub-pixel lab page](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/lab/04-subpixel/)
compares Silk with tessellated graphics.

---

# Radial menus and buttons

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/
Section: UI widgets

> Marking menus with nested rings, falloff and per-device tuning, plus buttons that animate in and out and ignore input while they move. Tree-shakeable.

Live demo `radial-menu` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import type { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { bindRadialTrigger, type RadialItem, RadialMenu } from 'pixi-silk/ui/radial';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Vector icons: drawn once in white around (0, 0); the menu tints them.
type Icon = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => void;
const pointer: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.triangle(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.42, s * 0.34, s * 0.06, -s * 0.06, s * 0.16, 2).fill(0xffffff);
    g.line(-s * 0.02, s * 0.12, s * 0.16, s * 0.42).stroke({ width: s * 0.12, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
const move: Icon = (g, s) => {
    const r = s * 0.42;

    g.line(-r, 0, r, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -r, 0, r).stroke({ width: s * 0.09, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 2;

        g.regularPoly(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, s * 0.14, 3, a + Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
    }
};
const rotate: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.arcSweep(0, 0, s * 0.32, -Math.PI * 0.35, Math.PI * 1.6).stroke({
        width: s * 0.1,
        cap: 'round',
        color: 0xffffff,
    });
    g.regularPoly(s * 0.18, -s * 0.3, s * 0.14, 3, Math.PI / 2, 1).fill(0xffffff);
};
const scale: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 0.1, s * 0.5, s * 0.5, 3).stroke({ width: s * 0.08, color: 0xffffff });
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.1, -s * 0.42, s * 0.52, s * 0.52, 3).fill(0xffffff);
};
const gear: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.33).stroke({ width: s * 0.16, dash: [s * 0.13, s * 0.13], color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.22).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
};
const more: Icon = (g, s) => {
    for (const x of [-1, 0, 1]) g.circle(x * s * 0.28, 0, s * 0.09).fill(0xffffff);
};
const heart: Icon = (g, s) => g.heart(0, 0, s * 0.8, 0.1).fill(0xffffff);
const star: Icon = (g, s) => g.star(0, 0, 5, s * 0.45, undefined, 0, 1.5).fill(0xffffff);
const plus: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.line(-s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.line(0, -s * 0.35, 0, s * 0.35).stroke({ width: s * 0.13, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};

const tools: RadialItem[] = [
    { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: pointer },
    {
        id: 'move',
        label: 'MOVE',
        icon: move,
        children: [
            { id: 'intuitive', label: 'Intuitive' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    {
        id: 'rotate',
        label: 'ROTATE',
        icon: rotate,
        children: [
            { id: 'uniform', label: 'Uniform' },
            { id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' },
            { id: 'free', label: 'Free' },
        ],
    },
    { id: 'scale', label: 'SCALE', icon: scale },
    { id: 'settings', label: 'SETTINGS', icon: gear, disabled: true },
    { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
];

// Press anywhere (or the round button) and drag to an item, or tap to keep the menu open.
// The `+` button opens a half ring that turns away from the edge it sits on.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 400],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        closeOnLeave: { type: 'toggle', label: 'close on leave', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const surface = new Container();
        const status = new Text({
            text: 'press, drag, release, or tap',
            style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13 },
        });
        const bounds = { x: 0, y: 0, width: 640, height: 400 };
        const report = (_item: RadialItem, path: readonly RadialItem[]) => {
            status.text = `picked  ${path.map((i) => i.id).join(' › ')}`;
        };
        const menu = new RadialMenu({ items: tools, bounds, ticker, onSelect: report });
        const quick = new RadialMenu({
            items: [
                { id: 'heart', label: 'LIKE', icon: heart },
                { id: 'star', label: 'FAVOURITE', icon: star },
                { id: 'plus', label: 'ADD', icon: plus },
                { id: 'more', label: 'MORE', icon: more },
            ],
            sweep: Math.PI * 0.9,
            innerRadius: 34,
            outerRadius: 92,
            bounds,
            ticker,
            onSelect: report,
        });
        const hub = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 64, icon: gear, iconSize: 28, ticker });
        const add = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 52, icon: plus, iconSize: 22, ticker });

        surface.eventMode = 'static';
        surface.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= 640 && y <= 400 };
        status.position.set(20, 18);
        hub.position.set(200, 210);
        add.position.set(586, 346);
        stage.addChild(surface, status, hub, add, menu, quick);

        bindRadialTrigger(surface, menu, { at: 'pointer' });
        bindRadialTrigger(hub, menu);
        bindRadialTrigger(add, quick);
        menu.state.hover.subscribe((item) => {
            if (item) status.text = `${menu.state.kind.value}: ${item.id}${item.disabled ? ' (disabled)' : ''}`;
        });

        tick(() => {
            menu.closeOnLeave = quick.closeOnLeave = params.closeOnLeave;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Import only what you use

Each widget has its own entry point. Nothing else comes along: the menu does not pull in the button,
and `pixi-silk/signal` has no Pixi code at all.

```ts
```

## Radial menus

```ts

const menu = new RadialMenu({
    items: [
        { id: 'select', label: 'SELECT', icon: drawPointer },
        { id: 'move', label: 'MOVE', icon: drawMove, children: [{ id: 'axis', label: 'Axis' }, { id: 'free', label: 'Free' }] },
        { id: 'delete', label: 'DELETE', icon: drawTrash, disabled: true },
    ],
    sweep: Math.PI * 2, // Math.PI for a half ring
    bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, width: app.screen.width, height: app.screen.height },
    onSelect: (item, path) => console.log(path.map((i) => i.id).join(' > ')),
});

app.stage.addChild(menu);
bindRadialTrigger(toolButton, menu); // or menu.openAt(x, y, event)
```

How it behaves:

- **Marking.** Press, drag towards an item, release: picked in one gesture. A tap opens the menu
  and leaves it up for a second tap.
- **Angle, not hit boxes.** Past the dead zone the whole wedge counts, out to the falloff
  distance. A fast flick lands on its item even when the pointer overshoots the ring.
- **Hysteresis.** The current item holds until the pointer is clearly past its edge, so a shaky
  finger on a boundary does not flicker between two items.
- **It stays.** Moving away does not close the menu. Set `closeOnLeave` to close it after the
  pointer stays outside the falloff area for a grace delay.
- **Nested rings.** Items with `children` open the next ring around themselves, to any depth.
- **Edges.** Full rings slide inside `bounds`. Partial rings turn to face the inside instead.
- **Per device.** Dead zone, falloff, size, tap time and hysteresis come from an input profile per
  pointer kind. Touch gets bigger targets and more forgiveness. Override any of it with `profiles`.

Icons are a string, a texture, a container or a function that draws with `SilkGraphics` in white.
The menu tints them, so hover colours cost no redraw.

## Buttons that know when to stay still

Live demo `spin-dock` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { signal } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { ButtonDock } from 'pixi-silk/ui/dock';
import { SegmentedSwitch } from 'pixi-silk/ui/modes';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const play = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => g.regularPoly(s * 0.06, 0, s * 0.42, 3, Math.PI / 2, 2).fill(0xffffff);
const minus = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) =>
    g.line(-s * 0.3, 0, s * 0.3, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.14, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
const plus = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    minus(g, s);
    g.line(0, -s * 0.3, 0, s * 0.3).stroke({ width: s * 0.14, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
// a lightning bolt as two rounded triangles (closed polygons cannot be filled yet)
const bolt = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.triangle(s * 0.12, -s * 0.5, -s * 0.3, s * 0.08, s * 0.08, s * 0.02, 1).fill(0xffffff);
    g.triangle(-s * 0.12, s * 0.5, s * 0.3, -s * 0.08, -s * 0.08, -s * 0.02, 1).fill(0xffffff);
};

// Tap SPIN for one spin, hold it for five. While the reels run, the side buttons leave, the speed
// switch locks and the spin button turns busy: nothing can be pressed twice. The bet lives in a signal.
const SPEED: Record<string, number> = { normal: 1.1, turbo: 0.6, quick: 0.3 };
export default defineDemo({
    size: [560, 340],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        enabled: { type: 'toggle', label: 'spin enabled', value: true },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const bet = signal(1);
        const reels = new SilkGraphics();
        const label = new Text({
            text: '',
            style: { fill: 0xf2f2f7, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '600' },
        });
        const side = { ticker, theme: { fill: 0x2c2c2e, fillHover: 0x3a3a3c, fillPress: 0x1c1c1e } };
        const less = new SilkButton({
            ...side,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 48,
            icon: minus,
            onPress: () => bet.update((b) => Math.max(1, b - 1)),
        });
        const more = new SilkButton({
            ...side,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 48,
            icon: plus,
            onPress: () => bet.update((b) => Math.min(10, b + 1)),
        });
        const speed = new SegmentedSwitch({
            ticker,
            value: 'normal',
            segmentWidth: 78,
            height: 34,
            options: [
                { id: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
                { id: 'turbo', icon: bolt },
                { id: 'quick', label: 'Quick' },
            ],
        });
        const spin = new SilkButton({
            ticker,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 76,
            icon: play,
            iconSize: 30,
            holdMs: 450,
            theme: { fill: 0x30d158, fillHover: 0x4ade80, fillPress: 0x248a3d },
            onPress: () => run(1),
            onHold: () => run(5),
        });
        const dock = new ButtonDock({ ticker, gap: 14 }).add(less, spin, more);
        let spinning = 0;
        let duration = 1.1;
        let left = 0;

        bet.subscribe((b) => (label.text = `bet ${b}`));
        label.text = `bet ${bet.value}`;
        label.anchor.set(0.5);
        label.position.set(90, 34);
        speed.position.set(400, 34);
        dock.position.set(280, 282);
        stage.addChild(reels, label, speed, dock);

        async function run(count: number) {
            left = count;
            spin.state.busy.set(true);
            speed.state.enabled.set(false);
            await Promise.all([less.hide(), more.hide()]);
            while (left-- > 0) {
                duration = SPEED[speed.state.value.value] ?? 1.1;
                spinning = duration;
                await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, duration * 1000));
            }
            spin.state.busy.set(false);
            speed.state.enabled.set(true);
            await dock.showAll();
        }

        tick((t, dt) => {
            spin.state.enabled.set(params.enabled);
            spinning = Math.max(0, spinning - dt);
            reels.clear();
            for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
                const x = 60 + c * 92;
                const run = spinning > 0 && spinning < duration * (1 - c * 0.05) ? 1 : 0;

                reels.roundRect(x, 62, 80, 168, 14, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
                for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
                    const y = 70 + r * 54 + (run ? ((t * 900 + c * 40) % 54) - 27 : 0);
                    const hue = [0xff453a, 0xffd60a, 0x0a84ff, 0xbf5af2][(r + c + (run ? Math.floor(t * 20) : 0)) % 4];

                    reels.roundRect(x + 12, y + 6, 56, 40, 10, 0.6).fill({ color: hue, alpha: run ? 0.55 : 0.9 });
                }
            }
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const spin = new SilkButton({ shape: 'circle', height: 76, icon: drawPlay, holdMs: 450, onPress: spinOnce, onHold: autoplay });
const turbo = new SilkButton({ label: 'Turbo' });

await turbo.hide();        // resolves when the animation ends
spin.state.busy.set(true); // spinner, input off
spin.state.active.subscribe((on) => console.log('accepts input', on));
```

A button only accepts input when it is shown, settled, enabled and not busy. `show()` and `hide()`
return promises that resolve `false` if the animation was reversed half way. A press that slides a
little off the button still counts on release.

`ButtonDock` lines buttons up and closes the gap when one hides. Slot sizes follow each button's
animated appearance, so the reflow and the fade move together.

## State in signals

Every widget keeps its state in `state`: small signals you can read, write and subscribe to. A
signal is a value with `subscribe`. There is no tracking magic, so it plugs into React, MobX or
plain callbacks.

```ts

const bet = signal(1);
const label = computed([bet], () => `bet ${bet.value}`);

bet.subscribe((now, before) => console.log(before, '->', now));
batch(() => {
    bet.set(2);
    bet.set(3);
}); // one notification
```

Widgets animate on `Ticker.shared` and leave the ticker once nothing moves. Pass `ticker` to use
your application's ticker, or `null` to step them yourself with `tick(dt)`.

---

# Transform gizmos

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/transform-gizmos/
Section: Editor UI

> Move, rotate, scale and bounding-box handles with snapping, selection outlines that follow rotated objects, and smart guides for edges, centres and gaps.

Live demo `gizmo` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { type GizmoMode, type GizmoSpace, TransformGizmo } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gizmo';
import { SelectionOutline } from 'pixi-silk/ui/outline';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Click a shape to select it, then drag the handles. Hold Shift to snap.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 420],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        mode: {
            type: 'select',
            label: 'mode',
            options: ['universal', 'move', 'rotate', 'scale', 'box'],
            value: 'universal',
        },
        space: { type: 'select', label: 'space', options: ['local', 'world'], value: 'local' },
        snap: { type: 'toggle', label: 'always snap', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const scene = new Container();
        const overlay = new Container();
        const background = new Container();
        const hover = new SelectionOutline({ ticker });
        const selection = new SelectionOutline({ ticker });
        const gizmo = new TransformGizmo({ ticker });

        background.eventMode = 'static';
        background.hitArea = { contains: () => true };
        background.on('pointerdown', () => {
            gizmo.attach(null);
            selection.select(null);
        });
        stage.addChild(background, scene, overlay);
        overlay.addChild(hover, selection, gizmo);

        const shape = (x: number, y: number, rotation: number, draw: (g: SilkGraphics) => void) => {
            const item = new Container();
            const g = new SilkGraphics();

            draw(g);
            item.addChild(g);
            item.position.set(x, y);
            item.rotation = rotation;
            item.eventMode = 'static';
            item.cursor = 'pointer';
            item.on('pointerover', () => hover.hover(item));
            item.on('pointerout', () => hover.hover(null));
            item.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                selection.select(item);
                gizmo.attach(item);
            });
            scene.addChild(item);

            return item;
        };

        const card = shape(190, 210, -0.2, (g) => g.roundRect(-70, -45, 140, 90, 18, 0.6).fill(0x30d158));

        shape(400, 150, 0.3, (g) => g.star(0, 0, 5, 52, undefined, 0, 6).fill(0xffd60a));
        shape(460, 300, 0, (g) => g.roundRect(-55, -30, 110, 60, 30).fill(0xbf5af2));
        selection.select(card);
        gizmo.attach(card);

        tick(() => {
            gizmo.state.mode.set(params.mode as GizmoMode);
            gizmo.state.space.set(params.space as GizmoSpace);
            // the box mode draws its own frame
            selection.alpha = params.mode === 'box' ? 0 : 1;
            gizmo.snap.enabled = params.snap;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Three pieces

```ts
```

Each one works alone. Put the outline and the gizmo in an overlay above your scene: they read the
target's transform every frame, so they follow it wherever it sits in the tree.

## Transform gizmo

```ts

const overlay = new Container();
const selectedShape = new Container();
const gizmo = new TransformGizmo({
    mode: 'universal', // 'move' | 'rotate' | 'scale' | 'box' | 'universal'
    space: 'local', // move along the object's own axes, or 'world'
    snap: { translate: 10, angle: Math.PI / 12, scale: 0.1 },
    onChange: (t) => console.log(t.x, t.y, t.rotation, t.scaleX, t.scaleY),
});

overlay.addChild(gizmo);
gizmo.attach(selectedShape);
gizmo.state.mode.set('rotate');
```

- **Move.** The arrows lock to one axis, the centre square moves freely.
- **Rotate.** The ring turns the object about its pivot. The swept angle is shaded and read out
  in a pill, and snap ticks appear while snapping.
- **Scale.** Cube handles stretch one axis, the centre ring (or the corner cube in universal mode)
  scales evenly. Scale handles follow the object's own axes in both spaces.
- **Box.** Eight handles resize in the object's own frame while the opposite side stays put.
  Shift keeps the aspect, Alt resizes from the centre. The zones right outside the corners rotate
  the box about its centre.

Moving the gizmo to another object pops it. The old handles shrink away where they were, and the
new ones spring in group by group: arrows first, then the ring, then the scale handles. The gizmo
ignores the pointer until they land. `transition: 'glide'` slides the handles over instead.

Shift snaps moves to the grid, angles to 15 degrees and scales to steps. Set `snap.enabled` to snap
by default, and Shift then turns it off. Handles light up under the pointer, step back while
another one is dragged, and grow under a finger.

The gizmo writes the new transform into the target. Pass `apply: false` to handle it yourself in
`onChange`, for undo stacks or networked editors. `gizmo.grab(event)` starts a move from a press
on the object itself, so a click on an unselected shape can select and drag it in one gesture.

The box handles assume the object is not mirrored (positive scales).

## Selection outline

```ts

const [shape, shapeA, shapeB] = [new Container(), new Container(), new Container()];
const hover = new SelectionOutline();
const selection = new SelectionOutline({ dash: [5, 4], march: 16, padding: 4 });

shape.on('pointerover', () => hover.hover(shape));
shape.on('pointerout', () => hover.hover(null));
selection.select([shapeA, shapeB]); // one box around both
```

The hover style is a quiet line. The selected style has marching dashes and corner brackets.
Rotated objects get a rotated box, several objects one box around all of them. The frame follows
its objects exactly while they move.

When the selection changes, the old frame shrinks and fades where it was, its dashes and brackets
retracting, while the new frame springs in around the new objects. Pass `transition: 'glide'` to
slide one frame over instead.

## Smart guides

Live demo `snap` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { TransformGizmo } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gizmo';
import { boundsQuad, SelectionOutline } from 'pixi-silk/ui/outline';
import { SnapEngine, SnapGuides } from 'pixi-silk/ui/snap';

import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Drag a card: edges and centres line up with the others, and equal gaps show their size.
// Hold Ctrl or Cmd to move without guides.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 380],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        spacing: { type: 'toggle', label: 'equal spacing', value: true },
        threshold: { type: 'range', label: 'threshold', min: 2, max: 16, step: 1, value: 6 },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const scene = new Container();
        const engine = new SnapEngine({ lines: { x: [320], y: [190] } });
        const guides = new SnapGuides({ ticker });
        const selection = new SelectionOutline({ ticker });
        const gizmo = new TransformGizmo({ ticker, mode: 'box', snapEngine: engine, snapGuides: guides });
        const cards: Container[] = [];
        const colors = [0x0a84ff, 0xff9f0a, 0x30d158, 0xbf5af2];
        const select = (card: Container | null) => {
            selection.select(card);
            gizmo.attach(card);
        };

        stage.eventMode = 'static';
        stage.hitArea = { contains: () => true };
        stage.on('pointerdown', () => select(null));
        stage.addChild(scene, guides, selection, gizmo);
        [
            [70, 80],
            [250, 80],
            [430, 120],
            [140, 240],
        ].forEach(([x, y], i) => {
            const card = new Container();
            const g = new SilkGraphics();

            g.roundRect(0, 0, i === 2 ? 140 : 110, 80, 14, 0.6).fill(colors[i]);
            card.addChild(g);
            card.position.set(x, y);
            card.eventMode = 'static';
            card.cursor = 'move';
            card.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                select(card);
                // press and drag in one go, even on a card that was not selected yet
                gizmo.grab(e);
            });
            scene.addChild(card);
            cards.push(card);
        });
        select(cards[3]);

        // what to snap against: every card, read as rectangles in the scene's space
        const refresh = () => {
            engine.targets = cards.map((c) => {
                const q = boundsQuad(c, scene);
                const xs = q.map((p) => p.x);
                const ys = q.map((p) => p.y);

                return {
                    x: Math.min(...xs),
                    y: Math.min(...ys),
                    width: Math.max(...xs) - Math.min(...xs),
                    height: Math.max(...ys) - Math.min(...ys),
                };
            });
        };

        gizmo.state.dragging.subscribe((on) => on && refresh());
        refresh();
        tick(() => {
            engine.spacing = params.spacing;
            engine.threshold = params.threshold;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

`SnapEngine` is plain maths with no drawing. Give it rectangles, guide lines and points, and ask
where a moving rectangle should go:

```ts

const otherRects = [{ x: 0, y: 0, width: 100, height: 60 }];
const engine = new SnapEngine({ threshold: 6, targets: otherRects, lines: { x: [320] } });
const box = { x: 103, y: 40, width: 80, height: 60 };
const r = engine.snap(box);

box.x += r.dx;
box.y += r.dy;
```

It aligns edges with edges and centres with centres, and also offers equal spacing: centred
between two neighbours, or at a gap that already exists in the row. `SnapGuides` draws the
result, with dashed lines and gap sizes in pills. Each alignment fades in when found and out when
lost, so guides never slide from one alignment to the next. Hand both to a gizmo with `snapEngine` and
`snapGuides` and its free moves snap on their own.

---

# Colour pickers

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/color-pickers/
Section: Editor UI

> Hue ring with triangle or square, colour wheel, OKLCH plane, channel sliders, swatches, a radial swatch popup and an eyedropper, all on one colour model.

Live demo `color-rings` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { ColorModel, ColorWheel, HueSquarePicker, HueTrianglePicker, SwatchPalette } from 'pixi-silk/ui/color';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Three pickers bound to one model: drag any of them and the others follow. Releasing a drag
// commits the colour into the recent row at the bottom.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [740, 330],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const model = new ColorModel({ color: 0x30d158 });
        const triangle = new HueTrianglePicker({ model, size: 220, ticker });
        const square = new HueSquarePicker({ model, size: 220, ticker });
        const wheel = new ColorWheel({ model, size: 196, ticker });
        const recent = new SwatchPalette({ model, columns: 12, size: 26, gap: 8, ticker });
        const chip = new SilkGraphics();

        triangle.position.set(20, 16);
        square.position.set(262, 16);
        wheel.position.set(506, 28);
        recent.position.set(64, 278);
        chip.position.set(20, 278);
        stage.addChild(triangle, square, wheel, recent, chip);
        for (const c of [0xff453a, 0xffd60a, 0x0a84ff]) {
            model.setHex(c);
            model.commit();
        }
        model.setHex(0x30d158);

        tick(() => {
            chip.clear().roundRect(0, 0, 32, 26, 8).fill(model.hex);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## One model, many pickers

Every picker edits a `ColorModel`. Give several pickers the same model and they stay in sync. The
model stores hue, saturation, value and alpha, so the hue survives greys and black. It also reads
and writes hex, RGB and OKLCH.

```ts

const model = new ColorModel({ color: 0x30d158 });
const triangle = new HueTrianglePicker({ model, size: 220 });
const wheel = new ColorWheel({ model, size: 196 });
const recent = new SwatchPalette({ model }); // no colours given: shows the recent ones

declare const brush: { tint: number };
declare function save(color: number): void;

model.value.subscribe(() => (brush.tint = model.hex)); // live, while dragging
model.committed.subscribe(() => save(model.hex)); // once per release
```

`value` changes on every move of a drag. Pickers call `commit()` when a drag ends, which adds the
colour to `history` and bumps `committed`.

## The pickers

- **`HueTrianglePicker`**: hue ring around a triangle with the pure hue, white and black at its
  corners. The triangle turns to face its hue.
- **`HueSquarePicker`**: hue ring around a saturation and value square.
- **`ColorWheel`**: hue around a disc, saturation from the centre out, value on a strip beside it.
- **`OklchPicker`**: lightness against chroma for one OKLCH hue, plus a hue strip. Colours keep
  their look as you move, and the part outside sRGB is greyed out.
- **`ColorSlider`** and **`ChannelSliders`**: gradient tracks for HSV, RGB, OKLCH and alpha. Each
  track shows what its positions would give with the rest of the colour unchanged.
- **`SwatchPalette`**: fixed colours or the recent ones, as a grid or a ring.
- **`SwatchPopup`**: a ring of swatches that opens around the pointer.
- **`Eyedropper`**: samples the scene through a function the app supplies.

A drag belongs to the part it started on. Start on the ring and the drag only turns the hue, even
across the square. Handles grow under a finger and glide when another picker moves the colour.

Live demo `color-oklch` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { ChannelSliders, ColorModel, checker, OklchPicker } from 'pixi-silk/ui/color';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Lightness against chroma for one OKLCH hue. The grey area is outside sRGB; dragging into it
// slides along the edge. The sliders edit the same colour in the chosen space.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [600, 260],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        sliders: { type: 'select', label: 'sliders', options: ['oklch', 'hsv', 'rgb'], value: 'oklch' },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const model = new ColorModel({ color: 0xbf5af2 });
        const plane = new OklchPicker({ model, width: 260, height: 180, ticker });
        const preview = new SilkGraphics();
        let mode = '';
        let sliders: ChannelSliders | null = null;

        plane.position.set(20, 20);
        preview.position.set(330, 196);
        stage.addChild(plane, preview);

        tick(() => {
            if (params.sliders !== mode) {
                mode = params.sliders;
                sliders?.destroy();
                sliders = new ChannelSliders({ model, mode: params.sliders as 'oklch', width: 220, ticker });
                sliders.position.set(330, 24);
                stage.addChild(sliders);
            }
            preview.clear();
            checker(preview, 22, 0, 220, 36, 10, 9);
            preview.roundRect(22, 0, 220, 36, 10).fill({ color: model.hex, alpha: model.alpha });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## OKLCH

OKLCH is lightness, chroma and hue in a space built to match how colours look. Moving lightness
does not shift the hue, and equal steps look equal. Not every OKLCH colour fits on a screen, so the
picker greys out the area outside sRGB and draws its edge. A drag into that area slides along the
edge.

```ts

const model = new ColorModel();
const plane = new OklchPicker({ model, width: 260, height: 180 });
const sliders = new ChannelSliders({ model, mode: 'oklch' }); // 'hsv', 'rgb'; alpha on by default
```

Live demo `color-popup` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { horizontal, SilkGraphics, vertical } from 'pixi-silk';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { ColorModel, Eyedropper, hsvToRgb, rgbToHex, SwatchPalette, SwatchPopup } from 'pixi-silk/ui/color';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Press anywhere on the artwork for the swatch ring: drag to a colour and let go, or tap to keep
// it open. The pipette samples the artwork (the app supplies the sampler, here plain maths).
const W = 600;
const H = 260;
const ART = { x: 20, y: 20, w: 420, h: 220 };
/** Colour of the artwork at a design-space point: hue across, value down. */
const artColor = (x: number, y: number): number | null => {
    const u = (x - ART.x) / ART.w;
    const v = (y - ART.y) / ART.h;

    return u < 0 || u > 1 || v < 0 || v > 1 ? null : rgbToHex(hsvToRgb(u * 360, 0.85, 1 - v * 0.8));
};
const pipette = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.line(-s * 0.32, s * 0.32, s * 0.12, -s * 0.12).stroke({ width: s * 0.16, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(s * 0.22, -s * 0.22, s * 0.16).fill(0xffffff);
};

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const model = new ColorModel({ color: 0xff9f0a });
        const art = new SilkGraphics();
        const surface = new Container();
        const popup = new SwatchPopup({
            model,
            colors: [0xff453a, 0xff9f0a, 0xffd60a, 0x30d158, 0x64d2ff, 0x0a84ff, 0xbf5af2, 0xffffff],
            ticker,
        });
        const chip = new SilkGraphics();
        const recent = new SwatchPalette({ model, columns: 4, size: 26, gap: 8, ticker });
        const dropper = new Eyedropper({
            model,
            ticker,
            // global canvas point -> design space of the demo
            sample: (gx, gy) => {
                const p = stage.toLocal({ x: gx, y: gy });

                return artColor(p.x, p.y);
            },
        });
        const button = new SilkButton({
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 44,
            icon: pipette,
            ticker,
            theme: { fill: 0x2c2c2e, fillHover: 0x3a3a3c, fillPress: 0x1c1c1e },
            onPress: () => dropper.start(),
        });

        art.roundRect(ART.x, ART.y, ART.w, ART.h, 14).fill({
            gradient: horizontal([0xff0000, 0xffff00, 0x00ff00, 0x00ffff, 0x0000ff, 0xff00ff, 0xff0000], {
                space: 'srgb',
            }),
        });
        art.roundRect(ART.x, ART.y, ART.w, ART.h, 14).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.15 });
        art.roundRect(ART.x, ART.y, ART.w, ART.h, 14).fill({
            gradient: vertical(
                [
                    [0, 0x000000, 0],
                    [1, 0x000000, 0.8],
                ],
                { space: 'srgb' },
            ),
        });
        surface.eventMode = 'static';
        surface.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= ART.x && y >= ART.y && x <= ART.x + ART.w && y <= ART.y + ART.h };
        surface.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
            const p = stage.toLocal(e.global);

            popup.openAt(p.x, p.y, e);
        });
        button.position.set(482, 42);
        chip.position.set(520, 20);
        recent.position.set(462, 96);
        stage.addChild(art, surface, chip, recent, button, popup, dropper);
        model.value.subscribe(() => chip.clear().roundRect(0, 0, 60, 44, 12).fill(model.hex));
        chip.roundRect(0, 0, 60, 44, 12).fill(model.hex);

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Swatch ring and eyedropper

The swatch popup works like the [radial menu](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/radial-menus-and-buttons/). Press, drag towards
a colour and let go, or tap to keep it open.

The eyedropper does not read pixels itself. Your app knows its scene, so it supplies a sampler.
That can be a texture lookup, `renderer.extract` on a render target, or plain maths.

```ts

declare const canvasArea: Container;
declare const pipetteButton: Container;
declare function colorAt(x: number, y: number): number | null;

const model = new ColorModel();
const popup = new SwatchPopup({ model, colors: [0xff453a, 0xffd60a, 0x30d158, 0x0a84ff] });
const dropper = new Eyedropper({ model, sample: (x, y) => colorAt(x, y) });

canvasArea.on('pointerdown', (e) => popup.openAt(e.global.x, e.global.y, e));
pipetteButton.on('pointertap', () => dropper.start()); // click to pick, Escape or right click to cancel
```

All pickers draw with pixi-silk gradients. Hue rings are conic gradients interpolated in sRGB, so
every angle is an exact HSV hue. The square and the wheel layer white and black ramps for exact
HSV colours. The OKLCH plane is drawn row by row, and chroma along a row is a straight line in
OKLab, so every row is exact too.

---

# Editor tools

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/editor-tools/
Section: Editor UI

> Action buttons that orbit the selection, a brush cursor with live resize and pen pressure, a hold-to-show mode ring and a sliding segmented switch.

Live demo `halo` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { ContextHalo } from 'pixi-silk/ui/halo';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Icons drawn in white around (0, 0). The halo tints them.
const copy = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.4, -s * 0.2, s * 0.55, s * 0.6, 3).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.15, -s * 0.45, s * 0.55, s * 0.6, 3).fill(0xffffff);
};
const trash = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.3, -s * 0.22, s * 0.6, s * 0.66, 3).fill(0xffffff);
    g.line(-s * 0.42, -s * 0.34, s * 0.42, -s * 0.34).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
const lock = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.roundRect(-s * 0.32, -s * 0.05, s * 0.64, s * 0.46, 4).fill(0xffffff);
    g.arcSweep(0, -s * 0.08, s * 0.2, Math.PI, Math.PI).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
};
const front = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.regularPoly(0, -s * 0.12, s * 0.3, 3, 0, 2).fill(0xffffff);
    g.line(-s * 0.3, s * 0.32, s * 0.3, s * 0.32).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
const paint = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.36).fill(0xffffff);

// Click a shape to select it. Drag it around: the halo follows and turns away from the edges.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 380],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        hideWhileDragging: { type: 'toggle', label: 'hide while dragging', value: false },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const world = new Container();
        const halo = new ContextHalo({
            items: [
                { id: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate', icon: copy },
                { id: 'paint', label: 'Colour', icon: paint },
                { id: 'front', label: 'Bring to front', icon: front },
                { id: 'lock', label: 'Lock', icon: lock, disabled: true },
                { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: trash },
            ],
            bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, width: 640, height: 380 },
            ticker: silk.app.ticker,
            onSelect: (item) => {
                const target = halo.state.target.value as SilkGraphics | null;

                if (!target) return;
                if (item.id === 'delete') {
                    halo.detach();
                    target.destroy();
                } else if (item.id === 'front') world.addChild(target);
                else if (item.id === 'paint') redraw(target, (Math.random() * 0xffffff) | 0);
            },
        });
        const redraw = (g: SilkGraphics, colour: number) => {
            g.clear().roundRect(-60, -40, 120, 80, 18, 0.6).fill(colour);
        };
        const backdrop = new Container();

        backdrop.eventMode = 'static';
        backdrop.hitArea = { contains: () => true };
        backdrop.on('pointerdown', () => halo.detach());
        stage.addChild(backdrop, world, halo);

        [
            [170, 190, 0x0a84ff],
            [420, 110, 0x30d158],
            [520, 300, 0xff9f0a],
        ].forEach(([x, y, colour]) => {
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            let grab = { x: 0, y: 0 };

            redraw(g, colour);
            g.position.set(x, y);
            g.cursor = 'grab';
            world.addChild(g);
            trackGesture(g, {
                onDown: (p) => {
                    halo.attach(g);
                    grab = { x: p.x - g.x, y: p.y - g.y };
                },
                onDragStart: () => halo.state.dragging.set(true),
                onDrag: (p) => g.position.set(p.x - grab.x, p.y - grab.y),
                onDragEnd: () => halo.state.dragging.set(false),
            });
        });
        halo.attach(world.children[0]);

        tick(() => {
            halo.hideWhileDragging = params.hideWhileDragging;
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Each tool has its own entry point and pulls in nothing else:

```ts
```

## Context halo

Round action buttons orbit the selected object, the way 3D and design tools show context actions.

```ts

const halo = new ContextHalo({
    items: [
        { id: 'copy', label: 'Duplicate', icon: drawMove },
        { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete', icon: drawTrash },
    ],
    bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, width: app.screen.width, height: app.screen.height },
    onSelect: (item) => console.log(item.id, halo.state.target.value),
});

app.stage.addChild(halo);
halo.attach(stage.children[0]); // the selected object
halo.state.dragging.set(true); // while the user drags the selection
```

- The buttons follow the target's bounds every frame, so drags, tweens and camera moves need no wiring.
- Selecting another object never slides the buttons across the scene. They pop out at the old
  object and pop back in around the new one, with a stagger. `transition: 'glide'` slides instead.
  Input is off while they pop.
- They sit on an arc that hugs the target's box, evenly spaced on wide and tall shapes alike.
- Near an edge of `bounds` the arc turns to the side with room, gliding round rather than jumping.
- While `state.dragging` is true they follow faster, or fold away with `hideWhileDragging`.
- A label pill shows on hover. Disabled items dim and ignore taps.

## Brush cursor

Live demo `brush` (source):

```ts
import { Container, RenderTexture, Sprite } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { BrushCursor } from 'pixi-silk/ui/brush';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Paint on the canvas. Hold F and move (or drag with the right button) to resize: sideways is
// size, up and down is hardness. [ and ] step the size. A pen's pressure shows as the inner disc.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 360],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, width, height }) {
        const surface = new Container();
        const canvas = RenderTexture.create({ width, height, resolution: silk.resolution });
        const dab = new SilkGraphics();
        const brush = new BrushCursor({ size: 36, hardness: 0.6, surface, ticker: silk.app.ticker });
        let painting = false;
        let last: { x: number; y: number } | null = null;

        surface.eventMode = 'static';
        surface.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= width && y <= height };
        stage.addChild(new Sprite(canvas), surface, brush);

        const stamp = (x: number, y: number, pressure: number) => {
            const { size, hardness, opacity } = brush.state;
            const r = (size.value / 2) * (0.35 + 0.65 * pressure);

            // soft brushes are a blurred dab, hard ones a crisp disc
            dab.clear()
                .circle(x, y, r * (0.6 + 0.4 * hardness.value))
                .fill({ color: 0x0a84ff, alpha: 0.35 * opacity.value, blur: r * (1 - hardness.value) * 0.6 });
            silk.app.renderer.render({ container: dab, target: canvas, clear: false });
        };
        const paintTo = (x: number, y: number, pressure: number) => {
            const from = last ?? { x, y };
            const step = Math.max(1, brush.state.size.value * 0.12);
            const n = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.hypot(x - from.x, y - from.y) / step));

            for (let i = 1; i <= n; i++)
                stamp(from.x + ((x - from.x) * i) / n, from.y + ((y - from.y) * i) / n, pressure);
            last = { x, y };
        };

        surface.on('pointerdown', (e) => {
            if (e.button !== 0 || brush.state.resizing.value) return;
            painting = true;
            last = null;
            const p = stage.toLocal(e.global);

            paintTo(p.x, p.y, e.pointerType === 'pen' ? e.pressure : 0.6);
        });
        surface.on('globalpointermove', (e) => {
            if (!painting || brush.state.resizing.value) return;
            const p = stage.toLocal(e.global);

            paintTo(p.x, p.y, e.pointerType === 'pen' ? e.pressure : 0.6);
        });
        const stop = () => {
            painting = false;
            last = null;
        };

        surface.on('pointerup', stop);
        surface.on('pointerupoutside', stop);

        return () => canvas.destroy(true);
    },
});
```

```ts

const brush = new BrushCursor({ size: 24, hardness: 0.8, surface: stage });

app.stage.addChild(brush);
brush.state.size.subscribe((size) => console.log('brush size', size));
```

- The ring is the brush size. A dashed inner ring shows hardness, and a disc grows with pen pressure.
- Small brushes get a crosshair, so the hot spot stays visible.
- Hold `F` (`resizeKey`) or drag with the right button to resize. The ring stays where the resize
  began, and a pill reads out size and hardness.
- `[` and `]` step the size. The OS cursor is hidden over `surface`.

## Mode switcher

Live demo `modes` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import type { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { ModeSwitcher, SegmentedSwitch } from 'pixi-silk/ui/modes';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

type Icon = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => void;
const brush: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.line(-s * 0.3, s * 0.3, s * 0.3, -s * 0.3).stroke({ width: s * 0.14, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(-s * 0.32, s * 0.32, s * 0.14).fill(0xffffff);
};
const eraser: Icon = (g, s) => g.roundRect(-s * 0.36, -s * 0.2, s * 0.72, s * 0.4, 4).fill(0xffffff);
const smudge: Icon = (g, s) => g.heart(0, 0, s * 0.7, 0.2).fill(0xffffff);
const fill: Icon = (g, s) => g.regularPoly(0, 0, s * 0.38, 6, 0, 3).fill(0xffffff);
const pick: Icon = (g, s) => {
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.3).stroke({ width: s * 0.1, color: 0xffffff });
    g.circle(0, 0, s * 0.08).fill(0xffffff);
};

// Hold Space over the canvas (or long-press it) for the mode ring, release on a mode.
// Tap Space to swap back to the previous mode. The pill below is a SegmentedSwitch.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 360],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, width, height }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const status = new Text({
            text: '',
            style: { fill: 0xf2f2f7, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '600' },
        });
        const hint = new Text({
            text: 'hold Space or long-press, tap Space to swap back',
            style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13 },
        });
        const speed = new SegmentedSwitch({
            options: [
                { id: 'slow', label: 'Slow' },
                { id: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
                { id: 'turbo', label: 'Turbo' },
            ],
            value: 'normal',
            ticker,
        });
        const tools = new SegmentedSwitch({
            options: [
                { id: 'brush', icon: brush },
                { id: 'eraser', icon: eraser },
                { id: 'smudge', icon: smudge },
                { id: 'fill', icon: fill },
                { id: 'pick', icon: pick },
            ],
            segmentWidth: 48,
            ticker,
        });
        const modes = new ModeSwitcher({
            modes: [
                { id: 'brush', label: 'BRUSH', icon: brush },
                { id: 'eraser', label: 'ERASER', icon: eraser },
                { id: 'smudge', label: 'SMUDGE', icon: smudge },
                { id: 'fill', label: 'FILL', icon: fill },
                { id: 'pick', label: 'PICKER', icon: pick },
            ],
            longPressTarget: stage,
            ticker,
        });

        stage.eventMode = 'static';
        stage.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= width && y <= height };
        status.anchor.set(0.5);
        hint.anchor.set(0.5);
        status.position.set(width / 2, 70);
        hint.position.set(width / 2, 100);
        tools.position.set(width / 2, 190);
        speed.position.set(width / 2, 290);
        stage.addChild(status, hint, tools, speed, modes);

        // the switcher and the toolbar share one source of truth
        const show = (mode: string) => {
            status.text = `mode: ${mode}`;
            tools.state.value.set(mode);
        };

        modes.state.mode.subscribe(show);
        tools.state.value.subscribe((id) => modes.set(id));
        show(modes.mode);

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const modes = new ModeSwitcher({
    modes: [
        { id: 'brush', label: 'BRUSH', icon: drawPointer },
        { id: 'eraser', label: 'ERASER', icon: drawTrash },
    ],
    longPressTarget: app.stage,
    onChange: (mode, previous) => console.log(previous, '->', mode),
});

app.stage.addChild(modes);
```

Hold the key and a ring of modes opens under the pointer, most recently used first, so the
previous mode sits on top. Release over a mode to switch. A quick tap of the key swaps back to the
previous mode without showing anything. On touch screens a long-press opens the same ring, and
sliding the finger picks.

The keyboard only acts while the pointer is over the canvas, and never while a text field has
focus. The ring is a `RadialMenu`, styled through the `menu` option.

## Segmented switch

```ts

const speed = new SegmentedSwitch({
    options: [{ id: 'slow', label: 'Slow' }, { id: 'normal', label: 'Normal' }, { id: 'turbo', label: 'Turbo' }],
    value: 'normal',
});

speed.state.value.subscribe((id) => console.log(id));
```

A pill of choices with a thumb that slides to the selected one. The leading edge moves first, so
the thumb stretches on the way and settles with a little give. Tap a segment, or press and slide
along the pill: the thumb follows the finger and the choice lands on release. Segments grow to fit
their labels or icons.
