# Dials and timeline

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/dials-and-timeline/
Section: Editor UI

> A jog wheel with fine control and inertia, Blender-style scrub fields, a compact timeline with keys and loop range, and an odometer that rolls its digits.

Live demo `dial` (source):

```ts
import { JogDial, Scrubber } from 'pixi-silk/ui/dial';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Drag around a dial: the value keeps adding up over full turns, and further out turns slower.
// Flick it to spin. The right dial clicks through steps and stretches past its limits.
// Scrub the fields sideways. Shift is fine, Ctrl or Cmd snaps, a tap on either end steps.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [600, 300],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const endless = new JogDial({ ticker, radius: 62, turn: 360, format: (v) => `${Math.round(v)}°` });
        const stepped = new JogDial({
            ticker,
            radius: 62,
            step: 1,
            min: 0,
            max: 24,
            value: 6,
            theme: { fill: 0x30d158 },
        });
        const size = new Scrubber({ ticker, label: 'Size', value: 24, step: 1, min: 1, max: 200, perPixel: 0.5 });
        const opacity = new Scrubber({
            ticker,
            label: 'Opacity',
            value: 0.8,
            step: 0.05,
            min: 0,
            max: 1,
            perPixel: 0.005,
            format: (v) => `${Math.round(v * 100)}%`,
            theme: { fill: 0xbf5af2 },
        });
        const angle = new Scrubber({
            ticker,
            label: 'Angle',
            value: 0,
            step: 15,
            perPixel: 1,
            format: (v) => `${v.toFixed(1)}°`,
        });

        endless.position.set(110, 130);
        stepped.position.set(290, 130);
        size.position.set(420, 70);
        opacity.position.set(420, 125);
        angle.position.set(420, 180);
        // the endless dial drives the angle field
        endless.state.value.subscribe((v) => angle.state.value.set(Math.round(v * 10) / 10));
        stage.addChild(endless, stepped, size, opacity, angle);

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## Jog dial

```ts

const camera = { zoom: 1 };
const undo: number[] = [];
const zoom = new JogDial({
    radius: 64,
    turn: 2,          // value change per full turn
    step: 0.1,        // detents: the value clicks through steps
    min: 0.1,
    max: 8,           // past a limit it stretches and springs back
    onChange: (v) => (camera.zoom = v),
    onCommit: (v) => undo.push(v),
});
```

Press anywhere on the dial and drag around its centre. The value follows the angle and keeps
adding up over full turns, so there is no seam at the top. Past the ring the dial turns slower the
further out the pointer is: move out for fine control without letting go. `fine` sets how quickly
that happens, and 0 turns it off.

A fast release keeps the dial spinning and `friction` slows it down. With `min` and `max` the ring
becomes a gauge of the range, and one turn covers the range unless `turn` says otherwise. Past a
limit the dial stretches like a rubber band and springs back. A tap on the right half steps up, on
the left half steps down. `onChange` fires on every snapped change, `onCommit` once the dial rests.

## Scrub fields

```ts

const size = new Scrubber({ label: 'Size', value: 24, step: 1, min: 1, max: 200, perPixel: 0.5 });
```

The number fields of 3D and compositing tools: drag sideways to change the value. Shift scrubs at
a tenth of the speed, and Ctrl or Cmd snaps to the step. A tap on either end steps down or up.
With `min` and `max` the field fills like a slider. A pill shows the value above the pointer while
dragging.

## Mini timeline

Live demo `timeline` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { JogDial } from 'pixi-silk/ui/dial';
import { MiniTimeline } from 'pixi-silk/ui/timeline';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Scrub the ruler (past the ends it stretches), drag keys, Shift-click or box-select several,
// and move the green loop handles. The wheel zooms, sideways or with Shift it pans, and a
// double tap on the ruler zooms in or back out. Tap the dial to play or pause.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [620, 220],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const timeline = new MiniTimeline({
            ticker,
            width: 470,
            height: 70,
            duration: 120,
            loop: [24, 96],
            keys: [0, 12, 30, 44, 60, 72, 90, 108].map((time, i) => ({ id: `k${i}`, time })),
        });
        const ball = new SilkGraphics();
        const jog = new JogDial({ ticker, radius: 34, thickness: 10, turn: 24, readout: false });
        let last = 0;

        timeline.position.set(20, 130);
        jog.position.set(560, 165);
        // the dial scrubs the playhead, a tap on it plays or pauses
        jog.state.value.subscribe((v) => {
            timeline.state.time.set(Math.max(0, Math.min(120, timeline.state.time.value + v - last)));
            last = v;
        });
        jog.on('pointertap', () => timeline.toggle());
        timeline.state.playing.set(true);
        stage.addChild(ball, timeline, jog);
        tick(() => {
            // something to animate: a ball eased between the keys
            const time = timeline.state.time.value;
            const keys = timeline.keys.map((k) => k.time).sort((a, b) => a - b);
            const i = keys.findIndex((k) => k > time);
            const a = keys[Math.max(0, i - 1)] ?? 0;
            const b = keys[i] ?? 120;
            const u = b > a ? (time - a) / (b - a) : 0;
            const y = 90 - Math.sin(Math.PI * u) * 60;
            const x = 20 + (time / 120) * 470;

            ball.clear();
            ball.circle(x, 108, 12).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.4, blur: 6 });
            ball.circle(x, y, 12).fill(0x0a84ff);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const timeline = new MiniTimeline({
    duration: 120,
    fps: 30,
    loop: [24, 96],
    keys: [{ id: 'jump', time: 30 }, { id: 'land', time: 44 }],
    onKeysChange: (keys) => localStorage.setItem('keys', JSON.stringify(keys)),
});

timeline.state.time.subscribe((frame) => console.log('frame', frame));
timeline.state.playing.set(true);
```

- **Scrub** the ruler. The playhead snaps to frames and stretches past either end of the track.
- **Keys** drag together when several are selected, snapped, and stop at the ends of the track.
  Shift-click adds to the selection, and a drag on empty track draws a selection box.
- **Loop range**: drag its green handles on the ruler. Playback wraps inside it.
- **Zoom** with the wheel around the pointer, pan sideways or with Shift. Pixi listens to the wheel
  passively, so the page scrolls too unless the canvas fills it. Without a wheel, a double tap on
  the ruler zooms in, and another zooms back out. `zoomBy`, `panBy` and `showAll` do the same from code.

State lives in `state`: `time`, `playing`, `selection`, `range` and `view`.

## Odometer

Live demo `odometer` (source):

```ts
import { Container } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Odometer } from 'pixi-silk/ui/odometer';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Tap the canvas to add a random amount. Bigger jumps count for longer, and a second tap while
// it counts skips to the end. The small readout below rolls frame numbers with a minimum width.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 240],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const panel = new SilkGraphics();
        const balance = new Odometer({ ticker, value: 1250, decimals: 2, prefix: '$', fontSize: 44 });
        const frame = new Odometer({
            ticker,
            minDigits: 4,
            thousands: '',
            fontSize: 18,
            color: 0x8e8e93,
            duration: 0.06,
            speedUp: false,
        });
        const hit = new Container();
        let f = 0;

        panel.roundRect(40, 40, 440, 110, 22, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
        balance.position.set(260, 95);
        frame.position.set(260, 190);
        hit.eventMode = 'static';
        hit.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x <= 520 && y <= 240 };
        hit.cursor = 'pointer';
        hit.on('pointertap', () => {
            if (balance.state.counting.value) {
                balance.skip();

                return;
            }
            const big = Math.random() < 0.25;

            balance.set(balance.state.value.value + (big ? 2000 + Math.random() * 40000 : 1 + Math.random() * 90));
        });
        stage.addChild(panel, balance, frame, hit);
        tick((_t, dt) => {
            f += dt * 12;
            frame.set(Math.floor(f));
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

```ts

const balance = new Odometer({ value: 1250, decimals: 2, prefix: '$', fontSize: 44 });

balance.set(9800);       // counts up, longer for bigger jumps (speedUp)
balance.skip();          // straight to the end
balance.state.counting.subscribe((on) => console.log(on ? 'counting' : 'done'));
```

Every digit column rolls on its own. A column only moves while the one below it passes from 9 to 0,
so carries ripple like a mechanical counter. Each column holds two glyphs at most. Glyphs come
from a bitmap font made from the text style, so a frame only moves them, and one mask clips them all.
`format(value)` returns the same text without rolling, for labels and accessibility.

# Gallery

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gallery/
Section: Examples

> Whole screens rebuilt with pixi-silk: a monochrome weather dashboard, a finance bento board and a sci-fi spectra HUD. Open any of them in Studio.

## Weather, in two tones

Live demo `weather-mono` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A monochrome weather dashboard. Static shapes redraw only while the theme fades, the needle,
// compass and sunrise arrow move on their own layer every frame.

const W = 390;
const H = 900;
const MONO = '"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace';

interface Palette {
    bg: number;
    card: number;
    disc: number;
    onDisc: number;
    ink: number;
    faint: number;
}

const LIGHT: Palette = {
    bg: 0xdcdedb,
    card: 0xebecea,
    disc: 0x1d1d1d,
    onDisc: 0xf2f2f2,
    ink: 0x1d1d1d,
    faint: 0x9a9c99,
};
const DARK: Palette = {
    bg: 0x000000,
    card: 0x1e1f21,
    disc: 0xe9eaea,
    onDisc: 0x111111,
    ink: 0xf2f2f2,
    faint: 0x6a6b6d,
};

const mix = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => {
    const ch = (s: number) => Math.round(((a >> s) & 255) + (((b >> s) & 255) - ((a >> s) & 255)) * t) << s;

    return ch(16) | ch(8) | ch(0);
};
const blend = (t: number): Palette => ({
    bg: mix(LIGHT.bg, DARK.bg, t),
    card: mix(LIGHT.card, DARK.card, t),
    disc: mix(LIGHT.disc, DARK.disc, t),
    onDisc: mix(LIGHT.onDisc, DARK.onDisc, t),
    ink: mix(LIGHT.ink, DARK.ink, t),
    faint: mix(LIGHT.faint, DARK.faint, t),
});

// layout: two columns of cards under the hero row
const COL = [20, 205];
const CARD_W = 165;
const CARD_H = 165;
const ROW = [330, 515, 700];
const hair = (color: number, alpha = 1) => ({ width: 1.25, color, alpha });

type Role = 'ink' | 'onDisc' | 'faint';

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    controls: {
        theme: { type: 'select', label: 'theme', options: ['light', 'dark'], value: 'dark' },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const base = new SilkGraphics();
        const live = new SilkGraphics();
        const texts = new Container();
        const labels: [Text, Role][] = [];
        let fade = params.theme === 'dark' ? 1 : 0;
        let drawnFade = -1;

        stage.addChild(base, live, texts);

        const text = (
            value: string,
            x: number,
            y: number,
            size: number,
            role: Role,
            anchor = 0,
            weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '400',
        ) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: value,
                style: {
                    fill: 0xffffff,
                    fontFamily: MONO,
                    fontSize: size,
                    fontWeight: weight,
                    letterSpacing: size * 0.08,
                },
            });

            t.anchor.set(anchor, 0.5);
            t.position.set(x, y);
            texts.addChild(t);
            labels.push([t, role]);
        };

        // header
        text('BROADGATE', W / 2, 92, 17, 'ink', 0.5);
        // hero
        text('12°', 115, 204, 66, 'onDisc', 0.5, '300');
        text('H:14° L:9°', 115, 254, 13, 'onDisc', 0.5);
        text('AIR QUALITY  21', 228, 162, 13, 'ink');
        text('Fair', 228, 184, 13, 'ink');
        text('UV INDEX 02', 228, 254, 13, 'ink');
        text('Low', 228, 276, 13, 'ink');
        // card titles and values
        const card = (col: number, row: number, title: string, sub: string, value: string, unit = '') => {
            const x = COL[col] + 16;
            const y = ROW[row];

            text(title, x, y + 22, 11, 'ink');
            if (sub) text(sub, x, y + 38, 11, 'ink', 0, '700');
            text(value, x, y + CARD_H - 26, 26, 'ink', 0, '300');
            if (unit) text(unit, x + value.length * 17 + 4, y + CARD_H - 22, 10, 'ink');
        };

        card(0, 0, 'AIR QUALITY', 'Fair', '21');
        card(1, 0, 'HUMIDITY', '', '79%');
        card(0, 1, 'WIND SPEED', '', '7', 'MPH');
        card(1, 1, 'UV INDEX', 'Low', '02');
        card(0, 2, 'SUNRISE', '', '06:11');
        text('N', COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 56, 9, 'ink', 0.5, '700');
        text('FEELS LIKE', COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 60, 12, 'onDisc', 0.5);
        text('11°', COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 100, 46, 'onDisc', 0.5, '300');

        const drawBase = (p: Palette) => {
            const g = base.clear();

            g.rect(0, 0, W, H).fill(p.bg);
            menuIcon(g, 28, 92, p.ink);
            gearIcon(g, W - 38, 92, p);
            g.circle(115, 218, 90).fill(p.disc);
            g.pill(212, 130, 160, 74).fill(p.card);
            g.pill(212, 222, 160, 74).fill(p.card);
            g.line(20, 318, W - 20, 318).stroke(hair(p.ink));
            for (const [col, row] of [
                [0, 0],
                [1, 0],
                [0, 1],
                [1, 1],
                [0, 2],
            ]) {
                g.roundRect(COL[col], ROW[row], CARD_W, CARD_H, 14).fill(p.card);
            }
            gaugeFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 108, p);
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 82, 46).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.6));
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 82, 37).fill(p.disc);
            compassFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 92, p);
            uvStack(g, COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 120, p);
            sunriseFace(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 92, p);
            g.circle(COL[1] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + CARD_H / 2, 82).fill(p.disc);
        };

        tick((t, dt) => {
            fade = damp(fade, params.theme === 'dark' ? 1 : 0, 6, dt);
            const p = blend(fade);

            if (Math.abs(fade - drawnFade) > 0.001) {
                drawBase(p);
                drawnFade = fade;
                for (const [label, role] of labels) label.tint = p[role];
            }
            const g = live.clear();

            gaugeNeedle(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[0] + 108, 0.28 + Math.sin(t * 0.7) * 0.04, p.ink);
            compassNeedle(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[1] + 92, 0.45 + Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.08, p.onDisc);
            sunriseArrow(g, COL[0] + CARD_W / 2, ROW[2] + 92, Math.sin(t * 1.6) * 2.5, p.ink);
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});

function menuIcon(g: SilkGraphics, x: number, y: number, color: number) {
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        g.circle(x, y + i * 7, 1.5).fill(color);
        g.line(x + 6, y + i * 7, x + 24, y + i * 7).stroke({ width: 1.5, color, cap: 'round' });
    }
}

function gearIcon(g: SilkGraphics, x: number, y: number, p: Palette) {
    g.star(x, y, 8, 13, 10.5, 0, 1.2).fill(p.ink);
    g.circle(x, y, 8.5).fill(p.bg);
    g.circle(x, y, 4).fill(p.ink);
    g.circle(x, y, 2.6).fill(p.bg);
}

function gaugeFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    const r = 50;

    g.line(cx - 72, cy, cx + 72, cy).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.arc(cx, cy, r, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    for (let i = 0; i <= 16; i++) {
        const a = Math.PI + (i / 16) * Math.PI;
        const inner = i % 4 === 0 ? r - 9 : r - 5;

        g.line(cx + Math.cos(a) * inner, cy + Math.sin(a) * inner, cx + Math.cos(a) * r, cy + Math.sin(a) * r).stroke(
            hair(p.ink),
        );
    }
}

function gaugeNeedle(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, value: number, color: number) {
    const a = Math.PI + value * Math.PI;
    const tipX = cx + Math.cos(a) * 44;
    const tipY = cy + Math.sin(a) * 44;
    const head = 7;

    g.line(cx, cy, tipX, tipY).stroke({ width: 1.5, color, cap: 'round' });
    for (const side of [-0.45, 0.45]) {
        g.line(tipX, tipY, tipX - Math.cos(a + side) * head, tipY - Math.sin(a + side) * head).stroke({
            width: 1.5,
            color,
            cap: 'round',
        });
    }
}

function compassFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    g.circle(cx, cy, 44).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.circle(cx, cy, 30).fill(p.disc);
    g.regularPoly(cx, cy - 47, 3.5, 3, 0, 0.5).fill(p.ink);
}

function compassNeedle(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, angle: number, color: number) {
    const dx = Math.sin(angle) * 24;
    const dy = -Math.cos(angle) * 24;

    g.line(cx + dx, cy + dy, cx - dx, cy - dy).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    const back = Math.atan2(-dy, -dx);

    for (const side of [-0.5, 0.5]) {
        g.line(cx - dx, cy - dy, cx - dx - Math.cos(back + side) * 6, cy - dy - Math.sin(back + side) * 6).stroke({
            width: 1.4,
            color,
            cap: 'round',
        });
    }
}

function uvStack(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    // `cy` is the shared base line: each ellipse sits on it, the tallest faintest
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const ry = 36 - i * 6.5;

        g.ellipse(cx, cy - ry, 46, ry).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.22 + i * 0.13));
    }
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, 46, 4.5).stroke({ width: 1.8, color: p.ink });
}

function sunriseFace(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, p: Palette) {
    g.line(cx - 72, cy, cx + 72, cy).stroke(hair(p.ink));
    g.arc(cx, cy, 52, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.45));
    g.arc(cx, cy, 40, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2).stroke({ width: 1.6, color: p.ink });
    g.line(cx - 52, cy + 10, cx + 52, cy + 10).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
    g.line(cx - 34, cy + 18, cx + 34, cy + 18).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
    g.line(cx - 12, cy + 26, cx + 12, cy + 26).stroke(hair(p.ink, 0.7));
}

function sunriseArrow(g: SilkGraphics, cx: number, cy: number, lift: number, color: number) {
    const top = cy - 26 - lift;

    g.line(cx, cy - 8, cx, top).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    g.line(cx, top, cx - 5, top + 6).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
    g.line(cx, top, cx + 5, top + 6).stroke({ width: 1.4, color, cap: 'round' });
}
```

Hairlines, discs and one monospace face. The needle, compass and sunrise arrow drift on their own layer.

## Finance bento

Live demo `finance-bento` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight, type TextStyleOptions } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, ease, SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { Odometer } from 'pixi-silk/ui/odometer';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A finance bento board. Every tile is its own container: it slides in on load, lifts on hover,
// and animates its numbers and bars once it has landed.

const W = 720;
const H = 900;
const GAP = 19;
const COL_W = (W - GAP * 4) / 3;
const col = (i: number) => GAP + i * (COL_W + GAP);
const SANS = 'Inter, "Helvetica Neue", system-ui, sans-serif';

const C = {
    page: 0x2a2a2a,
    orange: 0xf28a2e,
    orangeDeep: 0xd9762a,
    ink: 0x111111,
    stone: 0x8f8f8b,
    mist: 0xd9d9d6,
    paper: 0xf2f2f0,
    olive: 0x7f8b6c,
    oliveDeep: 0x5e6950,
    slate: 0x5a5a5a,
    arrow: 0xc4c4c4,
    clay: 0x7d5546,
    taupe: 0x857a5c,
    sand: 0xc8b88d,
    donut: 0x4a4a4a,
};

interface Tile {
    view: Container;
    /** 0..1 entrance progress, starts after `delay`. */
    enter: number;
    delay: number;
    lift: number;
    hover: boolean;
    /** Redraws the animated parts with the eased entrance value. */
    update?: (p: number, t: number) => void;
}

const label = (
    text: string,
    size: number,
    color: number,
    weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '500',
    extra: TextStyleOptions = {},
) => new Text({ text, style: { fill: color, fontFamily: SANS, fontSize: size, fontWeight: weight, ...extra } });

function tile(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, fill: number, delay: number, radius = 10): Tile {
    const view = new Container();
    const bg = new SilkGraphics();

    bg.roundRect(0, 0, w, h, radius).fill(fill);
    view.addChild(bg);
    view.position.set(x, y);
    view.eventMode = 'static';
    view.hitArea = { contains: (px, py) => px >= 0 && py >= 0 && px <= w && py <= h };

    const t: Tile = { view, enter: 0, delay, lift: 0, hover: false };

    view.on('pointerover', () => (t.hover = true));
    view.on('pointerout', () => (t.hover = false));

    return t;
}

function place(child: Container, x: number, y: number, ax = 0, ay = 0) {
    if ('anchor' in child) (child as Text).anchor.set(ax, ay);
    child.position.set(x, y);

    return child;
}

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const tiles: Tile[] = [];
        const bg = new SilkGraphics().rect(0, 0, W, H).fill(C.page);
        const add = (t: Tile) => {
            tiles.push(t);
            stage.addChild(t.view);

            return t;
        };

        stage.addChild(bg);

        // the 78% card: orange, with a progress bar
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 20, COL_W, 240, C.orange, 0));
            const value = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                prefix: '\u2248', // almost equal
                suffix: '%',
                fontSize: 52,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS },
            });
            const bar = new SilkGraphics();

            t.view.addChild(
                value,
                place(label('●  Winning\nInvestors', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 14, 100),
                place(label('2024 May', 22, 0xb5611d, '700'), 14, 150),
                bar,
            );
            value.position.set(COL_W - 14, 52);
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.2 && value.state.value.value === 0) value.set(78);
                value.x = COL_W - 14 - value.width / 2;
                bar.clear()
                    .roundRect(10, 186, COL_W - 20, 44, 4)
                    .fill(C.orangeDeep);
                bar.roundRect(10, 186, (COL_W - 20) * 0.7 * p, 44, 4).fill(C.ink);
            };
        }

        // up arrow tile
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 280, COL_W, 250, C.slate, 0.08));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;

            g.rect(cx - 9, 70, 18, 140).fill(C.arrow);
            g.beginPath()
                .moveTo(cx, 60)
                .bezierCurveTo(cx - 8, 90, cx - 40, 110, cx - 72, 110)
                .stroke({ width: 18, color: C.arrow });
            g.beginPath()
                .moveTo(cx, 60)
                .bezierCurveTo(cx + 8, 90, cx + 40, 110, cx + 72, 110)
                .stroke({ width: 18, color: C.arrow });
            t.view.addChild(g);
            t.update = (p, time) => {
                g.y = (1 - p) * 30 + Math.sin(time * 1.4) * 3 * p;
            };
        }

        // 24h trading volume
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(0), 550, COL_W, 330, C.clay, 0.16));
            const rows: [boolean, string, string][] = [
                [true, 'Bitcoin', '$67,258.69'],
                [false, 'Ethereum', '$2,631.39'],
                [true, 'Tether', '$0.9992'],
                [false, 'Solana', '$167.92'],
                [true, 'Cardano', '$0.362'],
                [false, 'Toncoin', '$5.25'],
            ];
            const lines = new SilkGraphics();

            t.view.addChild(place(label('24h Trading\nVolume', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 16, 20), lines);
            rows.forEach(([up, name, price], i) => {
                const y = 330 - (rows.length - i) * 37 + 12;

                lines.rect(0, y - 18, COL_W, 1).fill({ color: C.ink, alpha: 0.25 });
                t.view.addChild(
                    place(label(up ? '▲' : '▼', 10, C.ink), 16, y, 0, 0.5),
                    place(label(name, 13, C.ink, '600'), 34, y, 0, 0.5),
                    place(label(price, 13, C.ink, '600'), COL_W - 14, y, 1, 0.5),
                );
            });
        }

        // send / receive
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 20, COL_W, 170, C.stone, 0.04));
            const inner = new SilkGraphics();
            const send = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                fontSize: 38,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
            });

            inner.roundRect(8, 8, COL_W - 16, 72, 7).fill(0xadada9);
            inner.roundRect(8, 88, COL_W - 16, 74, 7).fill(C.mist);
            t.view.addChild(
                inner,
                place(label('Send', 16, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), 22, 30, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('USD', 11, 0x555555, '400'), 22, 64, 0, 0.5),
                send,
                place(label('Receive', 16, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), 22, 110, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('BTC', 11, 0x555555, '400'), 22, 146, 0, 0.5),
                place(label('0,0018', 38, C.ink, '400'), COL_W - 22, 136, 1, 0.5),
            );
            send.y = 54;
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.2 && send.state.value.value === 0) send.set(134);
                send.x = COL_W - 22 - send.width / 2;
            };
        }

        // research card: a price, then three plan cards stacked on its lower half
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 205, COL_W, 470, 0xbdbdba, 0.12));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const plans: [string, string, number, number][] = [
                ['Key\nBenefits', 'AI tools', 2, 0xdcdcda],
                ['Pricing\nPlans', 'Premium', 15, C.paper],
                ['Trusted\nInvestors', 'Trust', 54, C.taupe],
            ];
            const top = [214, 278, 342];
            const bottom = 462;
            const counters: Odometer[] = [];
            const trust = new SilkGraphics();
            const price = label('$23,485', 32, C.ink, '400');
            const cents = label('.95', 32, 0x8c8c8a, '400');

            t.view.addChild(
                g,
                place(label('Best Crypto\nResearch', 22, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 24 }), 16, 16),
                place(price, 16, 186, 0, 0.5),
                place(cents, 16 + price.width, 186, 0, 0.5),
            );
            plans.forEach(([name, sub, , fill], i) => {
                const y = top[i];

                g.roundRect(6, y, COL_W - 12, bottom - y, 8).fill(fill);
                const counter = new Odometer({
                    ticker,
                    fontSize: 40,
                    color: C.ink,
                    textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
                });

                counter.y = y + 38;
                counters.push(counter);
                t.view.addChild(
                    place(label(name, 11, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 12 }), 16, y + 10),
                    place(label(sub, 9, 0x5d5d5b, '400'), 16, y + 52, 0, 0.5),
                    counter,
                );
            });
            t.view.addChild(
                place(label('%', 18, 0x3b3b3b, '400'), COL_W - 80, top[2] + 44, 1, 0.5),
                place(label('Do not trust', 9, 0x4a4535, '400'), COL_W - 16, top[2] + 74, 1, 0.5),
                trust,
            );
            t.update = (p) => {
                counters.forEach((c, i) => {
                    if (p > 0.3 && c.state.value.value === 0) c.set(plans[i][2]);
                    c.x = COL_W - 18 - c.width / 2;
                });
                const barY = top[2] + 84;

                trust
                    .clear()
                    .roundRect(10, barY + 8, COL_W - 20, bottom - barY - 12, 6)
                    .fill(0x6c6450);
                trust.roundRect(10, barY, (COL_W - 20) * 0.54 * p, bottom - barY - 4, 6).fill(C.sand);
            };
        }

        // currency tiles
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(1), 690, COL_W, 190, 0xbdbdba, 0.2));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const half = (COL_W - 24) / 2;

            t.view.addChild(g);
            ['₿', '$', '€', '¥'].forEach((sign, i) => {
                const x = 8 + (i % 2) * (half + 8);
                const y = 8 + Math.floor(i / 2) * 91;

                g.roundRect(x, y, half, 83, 7).fill(C.paper);
                t.view.addChild(place(label(sign, 38, C.ink, '400'), x + half / 2, y + 42, 0.5, 0.5));
            });
        }

        // weekly bars
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 20, COL_W, 375, C.olive, 0.08));
            const bars = new SilkGraphics();
            const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
            const totals = [0.86, 0.75, 0.6, 0.68, 0.84, 0.67, 0.78];
            const filled = [0.3, 0.55, 0.18, 0.37, 0.75, 0.42, 0.28];
            const total = new Odometer({
                ticker,
                decimals: 2,
                prefix: '$',
                fontSize: 22,
                color: C.ink,
                textStyle: { fontFamily: SANS, fontWeight: '400' },
            });
            const slot = (COL_W - 24) / 7;

            t.view.addChild(
                place(label('You Shop\nData Insights', 20, C.ink, '700', { lineHeight: 22 }), 14, 14),
                bars,
                place(label('All Time:', 12, 0x2f3527, '400'), 14, 350, 0, 0.5),
                total,
            );
            days.forEach((d, i) =>
                t.view.addChild(place(label(d, 10, 0x3a4130, '400'), 12 + slot * (i + 0.5), 316, 0.5, 0.5)),
            );
            total.y = 350;
            t.update = (p) => {
                if (p > 0.4 && total.state.value.value === 0) total.set(637.55);
                total.x = COL_W - 14 - total.width / 2;
                bars.clear();
                totals.forEach((v, i) => {
                    const x = 12 + slot * i + 3;
                    const w = slot - 6;
                    const grow = ease.outCubic(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, p * 1.4 - i * 0.06)));
                    const full = 220 * v * grow;
                    const fill = 220 * filled[i] * grow;

                    if (full > 1) bars.roundRect(x, 300 - full, w, full, 6).fill(C.oliveDeep);
                    if (fill > 1) bars.roundRect(x, 300 - fill, w, fill, 6).fill(C.ink);
                });
            };
        }

        // one quarter donut
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 415, COL_W, 200, C.page, 0.16));
            const g = new SilkGraphics();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;

            t.view.addChild(g, place(label('¼', 40, C.paper, '500'), cx, 100, 0.5, 0.5));
            t.update = (p) => {
                g.clear().circle(cx, 100, 100).fill(C.donut);
                g.sector(cx, 100, 100, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.PI / 2) * p, 0).fill(C.mist);
                g.circle(cx, 100, 46).fill(0x262626);
            };
        }

        // clock dial with rotated numbers
        {
            const t = add(tile(col(2), 630, COL_W, 250, C.page, 0.24));
            const face = new SilkGraphics();
            const numbers = new Container();
            const cx = COL_W / 2;
            const cy = 125;

            face.circle(cx, cy, 122).fill(C.mist);
            face.regularPoly(cx + 20, cy + 40, 8, 3, -Math.PI / 6, 1).fill(C.ink);
            numbers.position.set(cx, cy);
            for (let h = 1; h <= 12; h++) {
                const a = (h / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
                const n = place(label(String(h), 30, C.ink, '400'), Math.sin(a) * 96, -Math.cos(a) * 96, 0.5, 0.5);

                n.rotation = a;
                numbers.addChild(n);
            }
            t.view.addChild(face, numbers);
            t.update = (p, time) => {
                numbers.rotation = (1 - p) * -1.2 + Math.sin(time * 0.3) * 0.04;
            };
        }

        tick((time, dt) => {
            for (const t of tiles) {
                const target = time > t.delay ? 1 : 0;

                t.enter = damp(t.enter, target, 5, dt);
                t.lift = damp(t.lift, t.hover ? 1 : 0, 14, dt);
                const p = ease.outCubic(Math.min(1, t.enter));

                t.view.alpha = p;
                t.view.pivot.y = (1 - p) * -24 + t.lift * 4;
                t.update?.(p, time);
            }
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Every tile is a small container with its own drawing, so you can lift any one of them into your app.

## Spectra HUD

Live demo `spectra-hud` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text, type TextStyleFontWeight } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A sci-fi spectrum readout. The frame, labels and gauges are drawn once, the heatmap cells and the
// orientation square redraw every frame.

const W = 1280;
const H = 720;
const CX = 640;
const CY = 360;
const MONO = '"JetBrains Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace';
const WHITE = 0xf2f2f2;
const DIM = 0x8a8a8a;
const RED = 0xff2b2b;

// heatmap grid: cells inside a circle around the centre
const CELL = 11;
const RADIUS = 150;
const GRID = Math.ceil((RADIUS * 2) / CELL);

const hair = (alpha = 1) => ({ width: 1, color: WHITE, alpha });

/** Blue to red to white, the palette of the hot spot. */
function hot(v: number): number {
    const stops = [0x1a2cff, 0xff1e1e, 0xffffff];
    const x = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, v)) * (stops.length - 1);
    const i = Math.min(stops.length - 2, Math.floor(x));
    const t = x - i;
    const ch = (s: number) => Math.round(((stops[i] >> s) & 255) * (1 - t) + ((stops[i + 1] >> s) & 255) * t) << s;

    return ch(16) | ch(8) | ch(0);
}

const grey = (v: number) => {
    const c = Math.round(30 + v * 170);

    return (c << 16) | (c << 8) | c;
};

export default defineDemo({
    size: [W, H],
    background: 0x050505,
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const frame = new SilkGraphics();
        const cells = new SilkGraphics();
        const live = new SilkGraphics();
        const texts = new Container();
        let frameCount = 0;

        stage.addChild(cells, frame, live, texts);

        const text = (
            value: string,
            x: number,
            y: number,
            size = 8,
            color = DIM,
            anchor = 0,
            weight: TextStyleFontWeight = '400',
        ) => {
            const t = new Text({
                text: value,
                style: { fill: color, fontFamily: MONO, fontSize: size, fontWeight: weight, letterSpacing: 0.6 },
            });

            t.anchor.set(anchor, 0.5);
            t.position.set(x, y);
            texts.addChild(t);

            return t;
        };

        drawTabs(text);
        drawWarning(frame, text);
        drawTitle(text);
        drawPlot(frame, text);
        drawTimeline(frame, text);
        drawCompassFace(frame, text);
        drawEdges(frame);
        drawControls(frame, text);
        drawFooter(frame, text);

        tick((t) => {
            // the heatmap redraws at half the frame rate: plenty for a slow drift
            if (frameCount++ % 2 === 0) drawCells(cells, t);
            live.clear();
            const a = t * 0.35;

            live.save().translateTransform(1165, 98).rotateTransform(a);
            live.rect(-11, -11, 22, 22).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffb020 });
            live.restore();
            live.line(1165, 98, 1165 + Math.cos(a - 1.2) * 46, 98 + Math.sin(a - 1.2) * 46).stroke(hair(0.5));
            const blink = Math.sin(t * 4) > 0 ? 1 : 0.35;

            live.circle(30, 680, 2.5).fill({ color: 0xffb020, alpha: blink });
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});

type TextFn = (
    value: string,
    x: number,
    y: number,
    size?: number,
    color?: number,
    anchor?: number,
    weight?: TextStyleFontWeight,
) => Text;

function drawCells(g: SilkGraphics, t: number) {
    g.clear();
    const hotX = 0.22 + Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.05;
    const hotY = -0.18 + Math.cos(t * 0.33) * 0.04;

    for (let j = 0; j < GRID; j++) {
        for (let i = 0; i < GRID; i++) {
            const x = CX - RADIUS + i * CELL;
            const y = CY - RADIUS + j * CELL;
            const u = (x + CELL / 2 - CX) / RADIUS;
            const v = (y + CELL / 2 - CY) / RADIUS;

            if (u * u + v * v > 1) continue;
            // a soft grey body, brighter towards its lower right, with a slow ripple
            const body =
                Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot((u - 0.05) / 0.9, (v - 0.15) / 0.75)) *
                (0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(u * 6 + t * 0.7));
            // the hot spot: a squashed blob that drifts inside the selection box
            const heat =
                Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot((u - hotX) / 0.42, (v - hotY) / 0.28)) * 1.25 +
                Math.max(0, 0.6 - Math.hypot(u - 0.2, v + 0.55) * 1.6);

            if (heat > 0.18) g.rect(x, y, CELL - 1, CELL - 1).fill(hot(heat - 0.18));
            else if (body > 0.04) g.rect(x, y, CELL - 1, CELL - 1).fill({ color: grey(body), alpha: 0.85 });
        }
    }
}

function drawTabs(text: TextFn) {
    const tabs = [
        'SPATIAL PREPROCESSING',
        'SPECTRAL PREPROCESSING',
        'UNIVARIATE IMAGING',
        'MULTIVARIATE IMAGING',
        'IMAGE PROCESSING',
    ];
    let x = 30;

    for (const [i, tab] of tabs.entries()) {
        const label = text(tab, x, 22, 7, i === 1 ? WHITE : DIM);

        x += label.width + 26;
    }
}

function drawWarning(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('IRP WARNING THRESHOLD  84%', 1205, 22, 7, WHITE, 1);
    g.roundRect(1215, 16, 36, 12, 2).fill(RED);
    text('HIGH', 1233, 22, 6, WHITE, 0.5, '700');
}

function drawTitle(text: TextFn) {
    text('06F', 40, 82, 30, WHITE, 0, '700');
    text('Neptune Spectra  /  Logged', 40, 112, 13, WHITE, 0, '600');
    text('APHELION', 40, 140, 6);
    text('30.33 AU (4.54 BILLION KM)', 40, 150, 7, WHITE);
    text('PERIHELION', 40, 168, 6);
    text('29.81 AU (4.46 BILLION KM)', 40, 178, 7, WHITE);
    text('C Time  19:28:24', 40, 486, 7);
    text('P Time  17:06:47', 40, 498, 7);
}

function drawPlot(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    g.circle(CX, CY, RADIUS + 18).stroke(hair(0.35));
    g.rect(CX - 125, CY - 105, 250, 250).stroke(hair(0.9));
    g.rect(CX - 20, CY - 195, 230, 230).stroke({ width: 1, color: WHITE, alpha: 0.9, dash: [4, 4] });
    g.roundRect(CX + 165, CY - 182, 34, 20, 2).fill(WHITE);
    text('06F', CX + 182, CY - 172, 8, 0x050505, 0.5, '700');
    for (const [i, exp] of ['10⁻⁰²', '10⁻⁰⁴', '10⁻⁰⁶', '10⁻¹⁴'].entries()) {
        text(exp, CX - 150, CY - 92 + i * 75, 9, WHITE, 1);
    }
    for (const [i, tick] of ['0.1', '1.0', '10.0'].entries()) text(tick, CX - 110 + i * 110, CY + 225, 10, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('ENERGY  [keV]', CX, CY + 250, 6, DIM, 0.5);
    const axis = text('FLUX  [1 / C M² S]', CX - 196, CY, 6, DIM, 0.5);

    axis.rotation = -Math.PI / 2;
    g.circle(CX - 6, CY + 2, 1.5).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawTimeline(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    const x0 = 560;
    const y = 74;

    text('TIMELINE', x0 - 14, y, 6, DIM, 1);
    for (let i = 0; i <= 40; i++) g.rect(x0 + i * 4, y - 2, 1, 4).fill({ color: WHITE, alpha: 0.35 });
    g.rect(x0 + 30, y - 6, 6, 12).fill(WHITE);
    for (const [i, m] of ['M1', 'M2', 'M3', 'M4', 'M5', 'M6'].entries()) {
        text(m, x0 + 20 + i * 30, y - 12, 6, i === 1 ? WHITE : DIM, 0.5);
    }
    g.rect(CX - 3, 34, 6, 14).fill(WHITE);
    g.rect(CX - 3, H - 48, 6, 14).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawCompassFace(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    const cx = 1165;
    const cy = 98;

    g.circle(cx, cy, 46).stroke(hair(0.6));
    for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
        const a = (i / 36) * Math.PI * 2;
        const r0 = i % 9 === 0 ? 40 : 43;

        g.line(cx + Math.cos(a) * r0, cy + Math.sin(a) * r0, cx + Math.cos(a) * 46, cy + Math.sin(a) * 46).stroke(
            hair(0.6),
        );
    }
    text('0°', cx, cy - 56, 7, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('90°', cx + 58, cy, 7, WHITE, 0);
    text('180°', cx, cy + 56, 7, WHITE, 0.5);
    text('-90°', cx - 58, cy, 7, WHITE, 1);
    text('ROT  -17°', 1140, 168, 6);
    text('SEQ  1.42', 1140, 180, 6);
}

function drawEdges(g: SilkGraphics) {
    g.line(20, CY, 200, CY).stroke(hair(0.3));
    g.line(W - 200, CY, W - 20, CY).stroke(hair(0.3));
    g.line(CX - RADIUS - 40, CY, CX - RADIUS - 18, CY).stroke(hair(0.6));
    g.line(CX + RADIUS + 18, CY, CX + RADIUS + 40, CY).stroke(hair(0.6));
    for (const x of [24, W - 24]) {
        g.circle(x, CY, 2).fill(WHITE);
        g.line(x, CY - 5, x, CY + 5).stroke(hair(0.8));
    }
    for (const x of [CX - 270, CX + 270]) g.circle(x, CY, 2).fill(WHITE);
}

function drawControls(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('R', 1214, 548, 11, WHITE, 0.5, '700');
    for (const [i, flip] of [false, true].entries()) {
        const y = 584 + i * 34;

        g.rect(1200, y - 12, 28, 24).stroke(hair(0.8));
        const s = flip ? -1 : 1;

        g.triangle(1214 - 5 * s, y - 6, 1214 - 5 * s, y + 6, 1214 + 6 * s, y).fill(WHITE);
    }
}

function drawFooter(g: SilkGraphics, text: TextFn) {
    text('SPECTRA / 06F', 46, 452, 7, 0x050505, 0, '700');
    g.rect(34, 444, 80, 16).fill(WHITE);
    text('FLUX  [1 / C M² S]', 42, 680, 6);
    text('ENERGY  [keV]', 42, 694, 6);
    g.rect(27, 691, 6, 6).fill(DIM);
    text('Selection  LDK 06F', 80, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('Form A', 560, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('1039 / 3972  E', 620, 700, 10, WHITE);
    text('Show Log', W - 30, 700, 7, WHITE, 1);
}
```

About 700 heatmap cells redraw at half the frame rate into one `SilkGraphics`, which is one draw call.

---

# Slot HUD examples

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/slot-hud/
Section: Examples

> Copyable slot HUD controls built from pixi-silk atoms: a spin button with autoplay, win meters, multiplier badges, free-spin pips, feature paths and hold-to-buy.

These controls are examples, not part of the library. Each demo is one file: open its source,
copy it into your game and restyle it. They are built from the same atoms as the library widgets:
`SilkGraphics`, `Spring` and `damp`, signals, `trackGesture` and `RadialMenu`.

## Spin button and autoplay

Live demo `slot-spin` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { damp, SilkGraphics, Spring } from 'pixi-silk';
import { signal } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { type GesturePoint, trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { type RadialItem, RadialMenu } from 'pixi-silk/ui/radial';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A slot spin button built from the atoms (copy it into your game and restyle it):
// idle breathing, press squash, hold for the autoplay picker, a stop square while spinning and the
// autoplay count left as a shrinking ring. The picker is a half RadialMenu fanning up from the button.

type Phase = 'idle' | 'spinning' | 'stopping';

class SpinButton extends Container {
    readonly phase = signal<Phase>('idle');
    readonly autoplay = signal(0);
    /** Spins in the current autoplay run, for the ring. */
    autoplayTotal = 1;
    onSpin: () => void = () => {};
    onStop: () => void = () => {};
    onHold: (p: GesturePoint) => void = () => {};

    private readonly g = new SilkGraphics();
    private readonly press = new Spring(0, 700, 30);
    private readonly morph = new Spring(0, 260, 22);
    private spinAngle = 0;
    private ring = 0;
    private t = 0;

    constructor(private readonly radius = 44) {
        super();
        this.addChild(this.g);
        this.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.hypot(x, y) <= radius + 10 };
        trackGesture(
            this,
            {
                onDown: () => (this.press.target = 1),
                onUp: () => (this.press.target = 0),
                onTap: () => (this.phase.value === 'idle' ? this.onSpin() : this.onStop()),
                onHold: (p) => this.phase.value === 'idle' && this.onHold(p),
            },
            { holdMs: 380, flickSpeed: 0 },
        );
    }

    update(dt: number): void {
        const spinning = this.phase.value !== 'idle';
        const r = this.radius;
        const total = Math.max(1, this.autoplayTotal);

        this.t += dt;
        this.press.step(dt);
        this.morph.target = spinning ? 1 : 0;
        this.morph.step(dt);
        this.spinAngle += dt * (2 + 8 * this.morph.value);
        this.ring = damp(this.ring, this.autoplay.value > 0 ? this.autoplay.value / total : 0, 10, dt);

        const breathe = spinning ? 0 : Math.sin(this.t * 2.4) * 0.025;

        this.scale.set((1 + breathe) * (1 - 0.08 * this.press.value));
        const m = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, this.morph.value));
        const g = this.g.clear();

        g.circle(0, 4, r).fill({ color: 0x000000, alpha: 0.35, blur: 10 });
        g.circle(0, 0, r).fill(spinning ? 0xff453a : 0x30d158);
        g.circle(0, 0, r - 5).stroke({ width: 2, color: 0xffffff, alpha: 0.25 });
        // the arrow turns into a stop square as the reels start
        g.save().rotateTransform(this.spinAngle * (1 - m) * 0.15);
        if (m < 0.5) {
            g.arcSweep(0, 0, r * 0.42, -Math.PI * 0.3, Math.PI * 1.45).stroke({
                width: 7,
                cap: 'round',
                color: 0xffffff,
                alpha: 1 - m * 2,
            });
            g.regularPoly(r * 0.12, -r * 0.42, 9, 3, Math.PI / 2, 2).fill({ color: 0xffffff, alpha: 1 - m * 2 });
        } else {
            const s = r * 0.42 * (m - 0.5) * 2;

            g.roundRect(-s / 2, -s / 2, s, s, 5).fill(0xffffff);
        }
        g.restore();
        if (this.ring > 0.002) {
            g.arcSweep(0, 0, r + 8, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 2 * this.ring).stroke({
                width: 4,
                cap: 'round',
                color: 0xffd60a,
            });
        }
    }
}

const chip = (n: string): RadialItem => ({ id: n, label: n });

export default defineDemo({
    size: [520, 320],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage, tick }) {
        const spin = new SpinButton();
        const status = new Text({
            text: 'tap to spin, hold for autoplay',
            style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 13 },
        });
        const picker = new RadialMenu({
            items: ['10', '25', '50', '100', '∞'].map(chip),
            sweep: Math.PI * 0.95,
            direction: -Math.PI / 2,
            innerRadius: 58,
            hub: false,
            outerRadius: 108,
            ticker: silk.app.ticker,
            theme: { segment: 0x2c2c2e, segmentHover: 0x3a3a3c, icon: 0xf2f2f7, iconHover: 0xffd60a, accent: 0xffd60a },
            onSelect: (item) => startAutoplay(item.id === '∞' ? 999 : Number(item.id)),
        });
        let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

        status.anchor.set(0.5);
        status.position.set(260, 30);
        spin.position.set(260, 250);
        picker.position.set(260, 250);
        stage.addChild(status, spin, picker);

        const spinOnce = () => {
            spin.phase.set('spinning');
            status.text = spin.autoplay.value > 0 ? `autoplay: ${spin.autoplay.value} left` : 'spinning';
            timer = setTimeout(() => {
                spin.phase.set('idle');
                if (spin.autoplay.value > 0) {
                    spin.autoplay.update((n) => n - 1);
                    if (spin.autoplay.value > 0) timer = setTimeout(spinOnce, 250);
                    else status.text = 'autoplay done';
                } else status.text = 'tap to spin, hold for autoplay';
            }, 1100);
        };
        const startAutoplay = (n: number) => {
            spin.autoplayTotal = n;
            spin.autoplay.set(n);
            spinOnce();
        };

        spin.onSpin = spinOnce;
        spin.onStop = () => {
            spin.autoplay.set(0);
            status.text = 'stopped';
        };
        spin.onHold = (p) => picker.openAt(260, 250, p);
        tick((_t, dt) => spin.update(dt));

        return () => {
            if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
        };
    },
});
```

The arrow morphs into a stop square while the reels run. The yellow ring shows the autoplay spins
left. Holding opens a half `RadialMenu` in marking mode, so press, hold, drag and release picks a
count in one gesture.

## Balance, win and bet

Live demo `slot-wallet` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { signal } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { JogDial } from 'pixi-silk/ui/dial';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { Odometer } from 'pixi-silk/ui/odometer';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Balance and win counters plus a bet dial, built on the library's Odometer and JogDial.
// Turn the dial to pick a bet from the ladder, press SPIN. Wins count up (tap the win to skip),
// then roll into the balance. Copy and restyle.

const LADDER = [0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100];
const money = { decimals: 2, prefix: '$' };
const label = (text: string, x: number, y: number) => {
    const t = new Text({ text, style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 12 } });

    t.anchor.set(0.5);
    t.position.set(x, y);

    return t;
};

export default defineDemo({
    size: [600, 340],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ silk, stage }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const betIndex = signal(3);
        const busy = signal(false);
        const panel = new SilkGraphics();
        const balance = new Odometer({ ticker, ...money, value: 500, fontSize: 30 });
        const win = new Odometer({ ticker, ...money, value: 0, fontSize: 40, color: 0xffd60a });
        // the dial turns through ladder positions: one detent per bet, a full turn covers the ladder
        const bet = new JogDial({
            ticker,
            radius: 62,
            value: betIndex.value,
            min: 0,
            max: LADDER.length - 1,
            step: 1,
            format: (i) => `$${LADDER[Math.round(i)]}`,
            onCommit: (i) => betIndex.set(Math.round(i)),
        });
        const spin = new SilkGraphics();
        const spinText = new Text({
            text: 'SPIN',
            style: { fill: 0xffffff, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontWeight: '700', fontSize: 16 },
        });

        panel.roundRect(30, 30, 260, 120, 20, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
        panel.roundRect(310, 30, 260, 120, 20, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
        balance.position.set(160, 100);
        win.position.set(440, 100);
        bet.position.set(160, 250);
        spin.position.set(440, 250);
        spinText.anchor.set(0.5);
        spinText.position.set(440, 250);
        stage.addChild(
            panel,
            label('BALANCE', 160, 55),
            label('WIN', 440, 55),
            label('BET', 160, 330),
            balance,
            win,
            bet,
            spin,
            spinText,
        );

        const drawSpin = () => {
            spin.clear()
                .circle(0, 0, 48)
                .fill(busy.value ? 0x3a3a3c : 0x30d158);
        };

        busy.subscribe(drawSpin);
        drawSpin();
        spin.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.hypot(x, y) <= 56 };
        trackGesture(spin, {
            onTap: () => {
                const stake = LADDER[betIndex.value];

                if (busy.value || balance.state.value.value < stake) return;
                busy.set(true);
                balance.set(balance.state.value.value - stake);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    const roll = Math.random();
                    const amount = roll < 0.45 ? 0 : roll < 0.9 ? stake * (1 + Math.random() * 4) : stake * 60;

                    if (amount === 0) {
                        busy.set(false);

                        return;
                    }
                    win.set(0);
                    win.skip();
                    win.set(Math.round(amount * 100) / 100);
                }, 600);
            },
        });
        // the win rolls into the balance when it finishes counting (or is skipped)
        win.state.counting.subscribe((counting) => {
            if (counting || !busy.value) return;
            const amount = win.state.value.value;

            setTimeout(() => {
                balance.set(balance.state.value.value + amount);
                win.set(0);
                busy.set(false);
            }, 500);
        });
        win.eventMode = 'static';
        win.hitArea = { contains: (x, y) => Math.abs(x) < 130 && Math.abs(y) < 50 };
        win.on('pointertap', () => win.skip());

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

Built on the library's `Odometer` and `JogDial`. The dial's detents are positions on a bet
ladder, and its readout shows the bet at that position.

## Meters, badges and pips

Live demo `slot-meters` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { conic, damp, SilkGraphics, Spring } from 'pixi-silk';
import { signal } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { trackGesture } from 'pixi-silk/ui/gesture';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Slot HUD pieces drawn with one SilkGraphics each, state in signals. Copy and restyle.
// Win meter with tiers, multiplier badge, free-spin pips, feature path and a hold-to-buy button.
// Press "WIN" to feed the meter, hold "BUY" to confirm.

const TIERS = [
    { at: 0.25, name: 'BIG', color: 0x30d158 },
    { at: 0.55, name: 'MEGA', color: 0x0a84ff },
    { at: 0.85, name: 'EPIC', color: 0xbf5af2 },
];
const font = { fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontWeight: '700' } as const;

export default defineDemo({
    size: [640, 360],
    touchAction: 'none',
    setup({ stage, tick }) {
        const win = signal(0); // 0..1 of the max win
        const mult = signal(1);
        const spins = signal(10);
        const used = signal(0);
        const path = signal(0); // feature collect progress, 0..6

        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        const tierText = new Text({ text: '', style: { ...font, fill: 0xffffff, fontSize: 18 } });
        const multText = new Text({ text: 'x1', style: { ...font, fill: 0x1c1c1e, fontSize: 22 } });
        const winBtn = new Text({ text: 'WIN', style: { ...font, fill: 0xffffff, fontSize: 14 } });
        const buyText = new Text({ text: 'HOLD TO BUY', style: { ...font, fill: 0xffffff, fontSize: 13 } });

        // one ramp over the whole gauge, so the colour says how far the win got
        const meterPaint = conic([0x30d158, 0x0a84ff, 0xbf5af2, 0xff375f], {
            center: [150, 170],
            units: 'local',
            startAngle: Math.PI * 0.75,
            sweep: Math.PI * 1.5,
        });
        let shown = 0;
        let tierPop = 0;
        let lastTier = -1;
        const badge = new Spring(1, 520, 14);
        let shake = 0;
        let pipPop = new Array(10).fill(0);
        let pathShown = 0;
        let buy = 0;
        let holding = false;
        let bought = 0;
        let time = 0;

        for (const t of [tierText, multText, winBtn, buyText]) t.anchor.set(0.5);
        tierText.position.set(150, 190);
        multText.position.set(380, 112);
        winBtn.position.set(150, 300);
        buyText.position.set(520, 300);
        stage.addChild(g, tierText, multText, winBtn, buyText);

        mult.subscribe(() => {
            badge.value = 1.45;
            shake = 1;
        });
        used.subscribe((u) => (pipPop[u - 1] = 1));

        // hit zones: a container per control keeps the example readable
        const zone = (x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number) => {
            const z = new SilkGraphics();

            z.hitArea = { contains: (px, py) => px >= x && px <= x + w && py >= y && py <= y + h };
            stage.addChild(z);

            return z;
        };

        trackGesture(zone(90, 280, 120, 40), {
            onTap: () => {
                win.update((v) => (v >= 1 ? 0 : Math.min(1, v + 0.12 + Math.random() * 0.1)));
                if (Math.random() < 0.5) mult.update((m) => (m >= 10 ? 1 : m + 1));
                if (used.value < spins.value) used.update((u) => u + 1);
                else {
                    used.set(0);
                    pipPop = pipPop.map(() => 0);
                }
                path.update((p) => (p >= 6 ? 0 : p + 1));
            },
        });
        trackGesture(
            zone(440, 280, 160, 40),
            {
                onDown: () => (holding = true),
                onUp: () => (holding = false),
            },
            { holdMs: 0, flickSpeed: 0 },
        );

        tick((_t, dt) => {
            time += dt;
            shown = damp(shown, win.value, 4, dt);
            badge.target = 1;
            badge.step(dt);
            shake = damp(shake, 0, 6, dt);
            pipPop = pipPop.map((p) => damp(p, 0, 5, dt));
            pathShown = damp(pathShown, path.value, 6, dt);
            buy = holding ? Math.min(1, buy + dt / 1.2) : damp(buy, 0, 10, dt);
            if (buy >= 1 && holding) {
                holding = false;
                bought = 1;
                buy = 0;
            }
            bought = damp(bought, 0, 2.5, dt);

            const tier = TIERS.reduce((acc, t, i) => (shown >= t.at ? i : acc), -1);

            if (tier !== lastTier) {
                if (tier > lastTier) tierPop = 1;
                lastTier = tier;
            }
            tierPop = damp(tierPop, 0, 5, dt);

            g.clear();
            // win meter: a 270deg gauge with tier ticks; the fill takes the colour of the tier reached
            const cx = 150;
            const cy = 170;
            const start = Math.PI * 0.75;
            const sweep = Math.PI * 1.5;

            g.arcSweep(cx, cy, 90, start, sweep).stroke({ width: 16, cap: 'round', color: 0x2c2c2e });
            if (shown > 0.003) {
                g.arcSweep(cx, cy, 90, start, sweep * shown).stroke({
                    width: 16,
                    cap: 'round',
                    gradient: meterPaint,
                });
            }
            for (const t of TIERS) {
                const a = start + sweep * t.at;

                g.line(
                    cx + Math.cos(a) * 76,
                    cy + Math.sin(a) * 76,
                    cx + Math.cos(a) * 104,
                    cy + Math.sin(a) * 104,
                ).stroke({
                    width: 2,
                    color: shown >= t.at ? t.color : 0x48484a,
                });
            }
            if (tier >= 0) {
                g.circle(cx, cy + 20, 34 + tierPop * 20).fill({
                    color: TIERS[tier].color,
                    alpha: 0.25 + tierPop * 0.4,
                    blur: 14,
                });
            }
            tierText.text = tier >= 0 ? `${TIERS[tier].name} WIN` : `${Math.round(shown * 100)}%`;
            tierText.scale.set(1 + tierPop * 0.35);

            // multiplier badge: a rounded star that pops and shakes when the value changes
            const bx = 380 + Math.sin(time * 60) * 4 * shake;

            g.star(bx, 112, 8, 46 * badge.value, 38 * badge.value, time * 0.4, 4).fill({
                color: 0xffd60a,
                blur: 0,
            });
            g.circle(bx, 112, 56 * badge.value).fill({ color: 0xffd60a, alpha: 0.18 * shake, blur: 12 });
            multText.text = `x${mult.value}`;
            multText.position.x = bx;
            multText.scale.set(badge.value);

            // free-spin pips: used ones fill, the newest one bursts
            for (let i = 0; i < spins.value; i++) {
                const x = 300 + i * 30;
                const y = 220;
                const on = i < used.value;

                g.circle(x, y, 9 + pipPop[i] * 6).fill({ color: on ? 0xff9f0a : 0x2c2c2e });
                if (pipPop[i] > 0.02) {
                    g.circle(x, y, 12 + (1 - pipPop[i]) * 16).stroke({
                        width: 2,
                        color: 0xff9f0a,
                        alpha: pipPop[i],
                    });
                }
            }

            // feature path: collect points along a wave, the trail grows to the reached point
            const pts: number[] = [];

            for (let i = 0; i <= 60; i++) {
                const t = i / 60;

                pts.push(300 + t * 300, 160 + Math.sin(t * Math.PI * 3) * 14);
            }
            g.polyline(pts, { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({ width: 6, cap: 'round', color: 0x2c2c2e });
            const reach = Math.round((pathShown / 6) * 60);

            if (reach > 0) {
                g.polyline(pts.slice(0, (reach + 1) * 2), { smooth: 'catmull' }).stroke({
                    width: 6,
                    cap: 'round',
                    color: 0x64d2ff,
                });
            }
            for (let k = 0; k <= 6; k++) {
                const i = k * 10;
                const on = pathShown >= k - 0.01;

                g.circle(pts[i * 2], pts[i * 2 + 1], on ? 8 : 6).fill(on ? 0x64d2ff : 0x48484a);
            }

            // buttons
            g.pill(90, 280, 120, 40).fill(0x0a84ff);
            g.pill(440, 280, 160, 40).fill(bought > 0.05 ? 0x30d158 : 0x3a3a3c);
            if (buy > 0.002) g.pill(440, 280, Math.max(40, 160 * buy), 40).fill({ color: 0xff9f0a, alpha: 0.9 });
            buyText.text = bought > 0.05 ? 'BOUGHT' : 'HOLD TO BUY';
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

## A dock that steps aside

Live demo `spin-dock` (source):

```ts
import { Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { signal } from 'pixi-silk/signal';
import { SilkButton } from 'pixi-silk/ui/button';
import { ButtonDock } from 'pixi-silk/ui/dock';
import { SegmentedSwitch } from 'pixi-silk/ui/modes';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

const play = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => g.regularPoly(s * 0.06, 0, s * 0.42, 3, Math.PI / 2, 2).fill(0xffffff);
const minus = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) =>
    g.line(-s * 0.3, 0, s * 0.3, 0).stroke({ width: s * 0.14, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
const plus = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    minus(g, s);
    g.line(0, -s * 0.3, 0, s * 0.3).stroke({ width: s * 0.14, cap: 'round', color: 0xffffff });
};
// a lightning bolt as two rounded triangles (closed polygons cannot be filled yet)
const bolt = (g: SilkGraphics, s: number) => {
    g.triangle(s * 0.12, -s * 0.5, -s * 0.3, s * 0.08, s * 0.08, s * 0.02, 1).fill(0xffffff);
    g.triangle(-s * 0.12, s * 0.5, s * 0.3, -s * 0.08, -s * 0.08, -s * 0.02, 1).fill(0xffffff);
};

// Tap SPIN for one spin, hold it for five. While the reels run, the side buttons leave, the speed
// switch locks and the spin button turns busy: nothing can be pressed twice. The bet lives in a signal.
const SPEED: Record<string, number> = { normal: 1.1, turbo: 0.6, quick: 0.3 };
export default defineDemo({
    size: [560, 340],
    touchAction: 'none',
    controls: {
        enabled: { type: 'toggle', label: 'spin enabled', value: true },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const ticker = silk.app.ticker;
        const bet = signal(1);
        const reels = new SilkGraphics();
        const label = new Text({
            text: '',
            style: { fill: 0xf2f2f7, fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif', fontSize: 15, fontWeight: '600' },
        });
        const side = { ticker, theme: { fill: 0x2c2c2e, fillHover: 0x3a3a3c, fillPress: 0x1c1c1e } };
        const less = new SilkButton({
            ...side,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 48,
            icon: minus,
            onPress: () => bet.update((b) => Math.max(1, b - 1)),
        });
        const more = new SilkButton({
            ...side,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 48,
            icon: plus,
            onPress: () => bet.update((b) => Math.min(10, b + 1)),
        });
        const speed = new SegmentedSwitch({
            ticker,
            value: 'normal',
            segmentWidth: 78,
            height: 34,
            options: [
                { id: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
                { id: 'turbo', icon: bolt },
                { id: 'quick', label: 'Quick' },
            ],
        });
        const spin = new SilkButton({
            ticker,
            shape: 'circle',
            height: 76,
            icon: play,
            iconSize: 30,
            holdMs: 450,
            theme: { fill: 0x30d158, fillHover: 0x4ade80, fillPress: 0x248a3d },
            onPress: () => run(1),
            onHold: () => run(5),
        });
        const dock = new ButtonDock({ ticker, gap: 14 }).add(less, spin, more);
        let spinning = 0;
        let duration = 1.1;
        let left = 0;

        bet.subscribe((b) => (label.text = `bet ${b}`));
        label.text = `bet ${bet.value}`;
        label.anchor.set(0.5);
        label.position.set(90, 34);
        speed.position.set(400, 34);
        dock.position.set(280, 282);
        stage.addChild(reels, label, speed, dock);

        async function run(count: number) {
            left = count;
            spin.state.busy.set(true);
            speed.state.enabled.set(false);
            await Promise.all([less.hide(), more.hide()]);
            while (left-- > 0) {
                duration = SPEED[speed.state.value.value] ?? 1.1;
                spinning = duration;
                await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, duration * 1000));
            }
            spin.state.busy.set(false);
            speed.state.enabled.set(true);
            await dock.showAll();
        }

        tick((t, dt) => {
            spin.state.enabled.set(params.enabled);
            spinning = Math.max(0, spinning - dt);
            reels.clear();
            for (let c = 0; c < 5; c++) {
                const x = 60 + c * 92;
                const run = spinning > 0 && spinning < duration * (1 - c * 0.05) ? 1 : 0;

                reels.roundRect(x, 62, 80, 168, 14, 0.6).fill(0x1c1c1e);
                for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
                    const y = 70 + r * 54 + (run ? ((t * 900 + c * 40) % 54) - 27 : 0);
                    const hue = [0xff453a, 0xffd60a, 0x0a84ff, 0xbf5af2][(r + c + (run ? Math.floor(t * 20) : 0)) % 4];

                    reels.roundRect(x + 12, y + 6, 56, 40, 10, 0.6).fill({ color: hue, alpha: run ? 0.55 : 0.9 });
                }
            }
        });

        return undefined;
    },
});
```

---

# Smooth graphics in PixiJS v8

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/smooth-graphics-pixijs/
Section: Rendering

> Find the cause and fix for jagged edges, faceted circles, flickering thin lines, blurry retina canvases, blurry filters and banded gradients in PixiJS v8.

Graphics in PixiJS v8 look rough for several reasons. Find your symptom below. Each section gives
the cause, then the fix. Most fixes work with plain `Graphics`, and each ends with the pixi-silk
equivalent.

## Jagged, stair-stepped edges

Anti-aliasing is off. `antialias` is `false` unless you set it, so every edge pixel is fully in or
fully out.

Turn on MSAA with `await app.init({ antialias: true })`. Or draw with `SilkGraphics`, which
computes exact edge coverage without MSAA. See [Anti-aliasing in PixiJS v8](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/antialiasing-in-pixijs/).

## Circles and curves look like polygons when zoomed

Graphics turns curves into a fixed number of segments when you draw them. Scaling the object up
later reveals the facets.

Raise `bezierSmoothness` (0 to 1, default 0.5) in `app.init()`, or redraw at the final scale. Or
use SilkGraphics. It evaluates circles, arcs and rounded corners exactly per pixel, at any zoom.

## Thin lines flicker, look dotted or disappear

A line thinner than one device pixel covers only a fraction of each pixel. Point samples (and
MSAA's four samples) hit it on some pixels and miss it on others. The pattern changes as the line
moves.

Keep strokes at least one device pixel wide and fade them instead. SilkGraphics does this for you
with energy-conserving hairlines:

Live demo `hairlines` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Lines thinner than a device pixel keep one pixel of width and fade instead of breaking up.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 220],
    controls: {
        scale: { type: 'range', label: 'width scale', min: 0.05, max: 2, step: 0.01, value: 0.5 },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();

        stage.addChild(g);
        tick((t) => {
            g.clear();
            for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) {
                const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i / 23) * Math.PI + Math.sin(t * 0.3) * 0.05;
                const w = (0.1 + i * 0.12) * params.scale;

                g.line(240, 200, 240 + Math.cos(a) * 220, 200 + Math.sin(a) * 190).stroke({
                    width: w,
                    color: 0xffffff,
                });
            }
        });
    },
});
```

## Everything is slightly blurry on retina or HiDPI screens

The canvas has fewer pixels than the screen. Either `resolution` is 1, or the browser scales a
canvas sized in CSS pixels. Or the size was rounded at a fractional DPR (1.25, 1.5), so the
browser resamples it.

Call `app.init({ resolution: window.devicePixelRatio, autoDensity: true })` and size the backing
store from `devicePixelContentBoxSize`. `createSilkApp` does both and follows DPR changes:

Live demo `resolution` (source):

```ts
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// A Siemens star is the hardest test for anti-aliasing: every wedge narrows below a pixel.
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 240],
    controls: {
        resolution: { type: 'select', label: 'resolution', options: ['device', '1x', '2x', '3x'], value: 'device' },
    },
    setup({ silk, stage, params, tick }) {
        const g = new SilkGraphics();
        let applied = '';

        stage.addChild(g);
        for (let i = 0; i < 36; i++) {
            const a = (i / 36) * Math.PI * 2;

            g.sector(240, 120, 110, a, a + Math.PI / 36).fill(0xffffff);
        }
        g.circle(240, 120, 110).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0x636366 });
        tick(() => {
            if (params.resolution === applied) return;
            applied = params.resolution;
            // createSilkApp sizes the backing store in device pixels; force 1x/2x/3x to compare
            silk.setResolution(applied === 'device' ? null : Number(applied[0]));
        });
    },
});
```

## Content behind a filter is blurry

Filters render into their own texture at `resolution: 1` by default.

Set `Filter.defaultOptions.resolution = 'inherit'` before you create filters, or pass `resolution`
to each filter. `createSilkApp` sets this default for you.

## Gradients show visible bands

The cause is 8-bit colour. A dark gradient across 1000 pixels may have only 20 distinct values.

The fix is dithering. Pixi's `FillGradient` has no dither option. pixi-silk bakes gradients in half
floats, interpolates in OKLab and dithers every sample by plus or minus half an 8-bit step. See
[Gradients](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/gradients/#no-banding).

## Slow motion snaps from pixel to pixel

`roundPixels: true` (on the renderer or the object) rounds positions to whole pixels.

Keep `roundPixels: false` for smoothly animated vector content. With analytic anti-aliasing,
sub-pixel positions render correctly.

## Checklist

```ts

const { app } = await createSilkApp({ parent: el });   // DPR-exact canvas, filters at screen resolution
const g = new SilkGraphics();                          // exact anti-aliasing, hairlines, dithered gradients
app.stage.addChild(g);
```

---

# Anti-aliasing in PixiJS v8

URL: https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/antialiasing-in-pixijs/
Section: Rendering

> Compare six ways to get smooth graphics in PixiJS v8: MSAA, higher resolution, curve smoothness, supersampling, FXAA and analytic SDF anti-aliasing.

Anti-aliasing removes the jagged "staircase" edges of shapes on a pixel grid. It gives each edge
pixel a partial colour, proportional to how much of it the shape covers. PixiJS v8 has five
practical options: MSAA (`antialias: true`), a higher resolution, finer curve tessellation,
supersampling and post-process FXAA. pixi-silk adds a sixth, **analytic anti-aliasing**. It
computes coverage from each shape's exact signed distance field, so it is exact at any zoom,
rotation and device pixel ratio.

Live demo `versus` (source):

```ts
import { Container, Graphics, Text } from 'pixi.js';
import { SilkGraphics } from 'pixi-silk';
import { defineDemo } from './runtime';

// Left: Pixi v8 Graphics (tessellated, no MSAA). Right: SilkGraphics (distance fields).
export default defineDemo({
    size: [480, 240],
    controls: {
        zoom: { type: 'range', label: 'zoom', min: 1, max: 6, step: 0.01, value: 1 },
        spin: { type: 'toggle', label: 'rotate', value: true },
    },
    setup({ stage, params, tick }) {
        const sides = [new Container(), new Container()];
        const pixi = new Graphics();
        const silk = new SilkGraphics();

        sides[0].addChild(pixi);
        sides[1].addChild(silk);
        sides.forEach((side, i) => {
            const mask = new Graphics().rect(i * 240, 0, 240, 240).fill(0xffffff);
            const label = new Text({
                text: i ? 'SilkGraphics' : 'Graphics',
                style: { fill: 0x8e8e93, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'system-ui' },
            });

            label.position.set(i * 240 + 12, 10);
            side.mask = mask;
            stage.addChild(side, mask, label);
        });
        let angle = 0;

        tick((_t, dt) => {
            if (params.spin) angle += dt * 0.15;
            for (const [i, side] of sides.entries()) {
                side.pivot.set(120, 130);
                side.position.set(i * 240 + 120, 130);
                side.scale.set(params.zoom);
                side.rotation = angle;
            }
            for (const g of [pixi, silk]) {
                g.clear();
                g.circle(120, 130, 62).stroke({ width: 3, color: 0x64d2ff });
                g.roundRect(70, 90, 100, 80, 24).stroke({ width: 1, color: 0xffffff });
                g.circle(120, 130, 18).fill(0xff375f);
                for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++)
                    g.moveTo(40, 60 + k * 3)
                        .lineTo(200, 64 + k * 5)
                        .stroke({ width: 0.6, color: 0xffd60a });
            }
        });
    },
});
```

## The options at a glance

| Technique | How to enable in PixiJS v8 | Edge quality | Cost | Applies to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| MSAA | `app.init({ antialias: true })` | 4 samples, so 5 coverage levels per edge pixel | memory bandwidth, resolve pass | main canvas (render textures and filters opt in) |
| Higher resolution | `resolution: devicePixelRatio, autoDensity: true` | smaller stairs, still aliased | fill rate grows with DPR squared | everything |
| Curve smoothness | `app.init({ bezierSmoothness: 0.9 })` | fewer facets on curves, edges still aliased | more triangles | Graphics curves |
| Supersampling (SSAA) | render into a 2x render texture, then draw it scaled down | high | 4x pixels, extra texture | what you render into it |
| FXAA | a post-process filter | softened edges, blurred detail and text | one full-screen pass | the filtered object |
| **Analytic SDF (pixi-silk)** | `new SilkGraphics()` | exact coverage, continuous | one instanced draw call | everywhere, including filters and render textures |

## How to enable MSAA in PixiJS v8

```ts

const app = new Application();
await app.init({
    antialias: true,                        // MSAA on the main canvas (WebGL context attribute)
    resolution: window.devicePixelRatio,    // render at device resolution
    autoDensity: true,                      // keep the CSS size
});
```

MSAA belongs to each render target, so it does not follow your objects everywhere:

- **Render textures** are not multisampled unless you create them with `antialias: true`.
- **Filters** render into their own targets with `antialias: 'off'` by default (`'on'` or
  `'inherit'` changes it). They also render at `resolution: 1` unless you raise it.
- **Thin lines** below one pixel still break up. Four samples cannot represent a line that covers a
  tenth of a pixel.

## Why MSAA is not enough for 2D UI

MSAA samples coverage at four fixed points per pixel. That is fine for large shapes at rest. The
things UI and charts are made of show its limits:

- Slowly moving or rotating edges jump between the five coverage levels, which reads as shimmer.
- Hairlines and small text-like strokes fall between samples and look dotted.
- Zooming reveals the tessellation of curves, because Graphics fixed its triangles when you drew.
- Fractional DPRs (1.25, 1.5, 2.625) add resampling blur, unless the canvas backing store matches
  the device pixels exactly.

## Analytic anti-aliasing with signed distance fields

A signed distance field (SDF) gives the distance from any point to the shape's edge. pixi-silk
evaluates each primitive's exact SDF per pixel. It turns the distance into coverage over exactly
one device pixel:

```glsl
float px = sqrt(abs(dFdx(p).x * dFdy(p).y - dFdx(p).y * dFdy(p).x)); // one device pixel, in shape units
float coverage = clamp(0.5 - d / px, 0.0, 1.0);                        // d: signed distance to the edge
```

The result is right at any scale, rotation, resolution and render target, because the pixel size
comes from screen-space derivatives. There is nothing to tessellate and no samples to miss. See
[How it works](https://pixi-silk.schmooky.dev/docs/how-it-works/) for details.

```ts

const { app } = await createSilkApp({ parent: document.body });   // antialias: false, DPR-exact canvas
const g = new SilkGraphics();

g.circle(200, 150, 80).stroke({ width: 2, color: 0x64d2ff });     // smooth at any zoom
g.roundRect(100, 60, 200, 180, 40, 0.6).stroke({ width: 0.5, color: 0xffffff }); // a clean hairline
app.stage.addChild(g);
```

## Which one should you use?

- For sprites and textures only, skip MSAA. The GPU filters textures.
- For occasional large shapes and no zoom, use `antialias: true` plus `resolution: devicePixelRatio`.
- For UI, charts, icons, thin lines and zoomable or rotating vector content, use analytic
  anti-aliasing with `SilkGraphics`. Keep `antialias: false` to save multisample bandwidth.
